runners.comment: Persian Force colt; 135,000gns Y; has some speedy siblings; dam Group-placed 2yo winner

runners.name: Thumama Glory
runners.spotlight: Cotai Glory gelding; second foal; dam 7.3f winner, half-sister to winners Vange (useful 6f 2yo) and Ronnie Baird (1m), is granddaughter of Irish Oaks winner Melodist.
runners.comment: Cotai Glory gelding; second foal; dam 7.3f winner, half-sister to two winners

runners.name: Hamidi
runners.spotlight: Siyouni colt; third foal; dam 1m/1m1f winner (inc Group 3; RPR 104), closely related to 1m2f Group 2 winner Hanalia, half-sister to 1m Group 3 winner Hunaina; family of Harzand.
runners.comment: Siyouni colt; third foal; dam 1m/1m1f winner (inc Group 3; RPR 104),  family of Harzand
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Maleo Matteo
runners.spotlight: Dark Angel half-brother to US 6.5f/1m turf winner I'm Otter Here (inc 2yo); dam 1m winner, closely related to 1m Listed winner Zhui Feng, half-sister to winners Dominant (HK 1m4f Group 1) and Es Que Love (7f Group 2).
runners.comment: Dark Angel half-brother to US 6.5f/1m turf winner I'm Otter Here (inc 2yo); dam 1m winner

runners.name: Selosse
runners.spotlight: Homebred Siyouni half-brother to yard's 1m/1m1f winner Green Impact (inc 2yo Group 2); dam runner-up 1m2f/13.5f, half-sister to winners Alphabet (Group-placed 6f) and Aerion Power (useful 7f/1m), out of half-sister to Irish 2,000 Guineas winner Power; has Group entries.
runners.comment: Homebred Siyouni half-brother to yard's 1m/1m1f winner Green Impact (inc 2yo Group 2)

runners.name: Senan
runners.spotlight: Bayside Boy colt; E75,000 Y; half-brother to eleven winners notably Katla (6f inc 2yo/Listed) and Rapid Reaction (Group-placed 5f).
runners.comment: Bayside Boy colt; E75,000 Y; half-brother to eleven winners notably Katla (6f inc Listed)

runners.name: Ar Son Na Cuise
runners.spotlight: Churchill gelding; first foal of unraced half-sister to winners My Renee (1m4f Listed) and Sutters Fort (useful 6f/7f 2yo); family of Arc winners Carnegie and Detroit.
runners.comment: Churchill gelding; dam unraced half-sister to winners My Renee (Listed) and Sutters Fort

runners.name: Hazaraf
runners.spotlight: Blue Point colt is closely related to French Group-placed 6f winner Haziym, half-brother to 7f 2yo winner Hazdann; dam twice-raced 7f winner, out of Group-placed 1m2f winning half-sister to Derby/Irish Derby winner Harzand; has a Group 1 entry and stable jockey rides.
runners.comment: Blue Point colt is related to winners; has a Group 1 entry and stable jockey rides
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Monogram
runners.spotlight: Kingman brother to French 1m1f winner Life Study; dam 1m-1m1f winner (inc French 2yo Group 3/US Grade 3), half-sister to winners Better Together (7f/1m Group 3), Yesyes (14.4f Listed) and Sand Share (Group-placed 7f 2yo); has a Dewhurst entry.
runners.comment: Kingman brother to French 1m1f winner Life Stud, out of  French 2yo Group 3 winner

runners.name: Noble Exhibit
runners.spotlight: Frankel brother to winners Propose (1m2f) and Minerva (Group-placed 7f 2yo), closely related to 1m winner History (inc 2yo/Group 3); dam 6f-1m winner (inc 2yo/AW/US Grade 2; 110), sister to 1m Group 1 winner Mohaather.
runners.comment: Frankel colt closely related to 1m winner History (inc 2yo/Group 3) out of useful racemare

runners.name: Timucua Gold
runners.spotlight: By the Uncle Mo stallion Yaupon; $120,000 Y, failed to sell at the breeze-ups; dam placed US 6f dirt/AW (inc 2yo), half-sister to US Graded winners.
runners.comment: By the Uncle Mo stallion Yaupon; $120,000 Y, failed to sell at the breeze-ups

runners.name: War Artist
runners.spotlight: New Bay colt; 300,000gns Y; closely related to 1m 2yo/1m1f Australian winner Modesty, half-brother to winners Stalingrad (6f) and Modelling (French 6.5f); dam 6f 2yo Group 3 winner (99), half-sister to 7f/1m 2yo Group 1 winner; has a Group 1 entry.
runners.comment: New Bay colt; 300,000gns Y; related to winners and out of 6f 2yo Group 3 winner

races.race_name: Moloney's Bar And Music Venue Maiden

runners.name: Let's Smash It
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer has put in three solid efforts; led when third at Leopardstown, little over a length behind Handani then.
runners.comment: Led when third at Leopardstown, little over a length behind Handani then.

runners.name: Handani
runners.spotlight: A place ahead of smart Enceladus when second at Naas last year; off the bridle a long way out when second on his return at Leopardstown (1m1f), and not mad about his head carriage that day.
runners.comment: Off the bridle a long way out when second on his return at Leopardstown (1m1f)
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Will You Stop
runners.spotlight: Didn't seem to stay 1m4f latest but earlier runs, including 3l fourth over C&D, make him worthy of his mark.
runners.comment: Didn't seem to stay 1m4f latest,  but earlier runs make him worthy of his mark

runners.name: Lord Darragh
runners.spotlight: Big prices, but has shown plenty so far; just ahead of 79-rated foe when second over 9.5f at Gowran, so he'll need a bit more; yard won Leopardstown maiden on Thursday.
runners.comment: Just ahead of 79-rated foe when second over 9.5f at Gowran, so he'll need a bit more.

runners.name: Saxony Charms
runners.spotlight: Both runs over C&D; beaten a length on debut but 3l fifth last time was of equal merit; closely matched with Will You Stop on that form; headgear.
runners.comment: Both runs over C&D; beaten a length on debut but 3l fifth last time was of equal merit
runners.owner: Team Valor International LLC & A Oliver

runners.name: Acula
runners.spotlight: Sea The Stars half-sister to yard's Group 3 winner Starford; lovely debut over a mile at Naas, missed the break and was green, finished well under a hand ride when fourth to a better-fancied stablemate.
runners.comment: Lovely debut over a mile at Naas; finished well when fourth to a better-fancied stablemate

runners.name: Royal Ballet Blue
runners.spotlight: Elzaam colt; dam unraced half-sister to Scandinavian 1m-8.6f winner, out of 1m2f winning half-sister to Listed winners Coupe De Ville (1m 2yo) and Fantastico Robert (US 1m1f); young trainer having a good season, but this one is best watched unless backed.
runners.comment: Elzaam colt; dam unraced half-sister to Scandinavian 1m-8.6f winner, trainer doing well

runners.name: Ard Ri Na Heireann
runners.spotlight: Out the back in a bumper in May; will need more experience.
runners.comment: Out the back in a bumper in May; will need more experience

runners.name: Montevetro
runners.spotlight: Bolger-bred went from 800,000gns as a yearling to 20,000gns 3yo last month; better of two March AW runs for Charlie Appleby when second over this trip at Chelmsford.
runners.comment: Better of two March AW runs for Charlie Appleby when second over this trip at Chelmsford

runners.name: Zarenakarena
runners.spotlight: 100-1, missed the break when beaten 12l over a mile at Naas.
runners.comment: 100-1, missed the break when beaten 12l over a mile at Naas

runners.name: The Austrian
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Snowcapped (Listed-placed 7f/mile) and It's Snowing (6f AW 2yo), 16s, yard second string, ran respectably following a slow start when beaten around 9l at Gowran in early June (yard won it with favourite).
runners.comment: Ran respectably following a slow start when beaten around 9l at Gowran in early June.

runners.name: Giordano
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way at Fairyhouse; gelded.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way at Fairyhouse; gelded

races.race_name: Mitsubishi Electric Handicap

runners.name: Gavoo
runners.spotlight: A little bit hard to figure him out but, to be charitable, probably still learning his trade; unlucky fourth to Chicago Pope early in the season; staying-on fifth of 20 in the Scurry here was a good effort; ridden 2f out and just stuck on one-paced when third at Naas latest; visored last twice, now goes unaided.
runners.comment: Staying-on fifth of 20 in the Scurry here and fair third at Naas latest; visor binned

runners.name: Keke
runners.spotlight: 7f and Cork not really his bag, so not a bad effort at all when beaten less than 2l in Listed company last time; previous fourth of 20 in British-dominated Scurry handicap was creditable too, and will have every chance if he gets the right set-up.
runners.comment: 7f and Cork not really his bag, so not a bad effort last time; every chance if gets breaks

runners.name: Rock Iguana
runners.spotlight: Reasonable AW form in Britain before being picked up for 15,000gns in July; mid-field in 7f claimer on stable debut; will do well to get competitive in this, unless new headgear works.
runners.comment: Mid-field in 7f claimer on stable debut; will do well to get competitive in this

runners.name: Chicago Pope
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer followed up Naas win with 3l fourth of 22 at York in June; that valuable race has worked out pretty well, as it usually does, and it was a good effort for an Irish sprinter in such a competitive British sprint.
runners.comment: Prominent racer followed up Naas win with 3l fourth of 22 at York in June (solid form)
runners.owner: Anthony Paul Smurfit & Samuel M Mencoff

runners.name: Howd'yadoit
runners.spotlight: Won off 91 at Navan (5f) in May, but it's been a struggle since and hard to fancy at present.
runners.comment: Won off 91 at Navan (5f) in May, but it's been a struggle since and hard to fancy for now

runners.name: Finika
runners.spotlight: Won Cork maiden over this trip on third start; last of 12 over 5f here on handicap debut; doubtless she's better than that, but hard to face into all the same.
runners.comment: Won Cork maiden over this trip on third start; last of 12 over 5f here on handicap debut

runners.name: Genesis
runners.spotlight: Succession of good runs over various sprint trips here this year; won the Rockingham in June and good second over that 5f distance last time; previously, had four of these behind when third in the Scurry over an extended 6f, which was a bit too far.
runners.comment: Succession of good runs over various sprint trips here this year; second over 5f last time

runners.name: Go Athletico
runners.spotlight: Last win came in last year's Scurry here over slightly farther; some good runs this season, but basically he's in the handicapper's grip; went back up 4lb for Galway second over 7f, not as effective over 5f when favourite here last time.
runners.comment: Some good runs this season but basically, he's in the handicapper's grip

runners.name: Bear On The Run
runners.spotlight: Promising debut over C&D in May 2025 before easily scoring at Dundalk by 3.25l; ordinary form, but looked potentially useful that day; off over a year and would be a smart effort to beat these on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Promising debut over C&D in May 2025 before easily scoring at Dundalk by 3.25l; off a year
runners.owner: Kildare Racing Syndicate & Kilmichael Racing Syndicate

runners.name: Gotta Catch'em All
runners.spotlight: Has been a revelation since dropping back to this trip with the addition of blinkers, and being ridden forward; just worn down late at Naas (Gavoo third) last time; wrong at the weights, so 5lb higher now.
runners.comment: After back-to-back wins, just worn down late at Naas (Gavoo third) last time; 5lb higher
runners.owner: Mrs S Bury & Ralph Kelly & Odhran O'Neill & Thomas Cox

runners.name: Moltophino
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 25 starts came when he beat Keke over C&D last year; couple of excuses this term (raced on wrong side at Naas last time) and has inched back down to winning mark; blinkers replace visor.
runners.comment: Sole win in 25 starts came when he beat Keke over C&D last year; back down to winning mark

runners.name: Jon Riggens
runners.spotlight: Three wins here; struck for the first time since 2024 when winning at Navan in June; may have benefitted from track position (only runner-up and himself raced far side), but in fairness, second won lately; missed an engagement here earlier this month and profile suggests layoff not ideal; 3lb wrong, but top 'bug' rides.
runners.comment: Aided by track position when winning at Navan in June; absence since then not ideal

races.race_name: Alpha Centauri Debutante Stakes (Group 2) (Fillies)

runners.name: Alpha
runners.spotlight: Regally bred Sea The Stars filly; narrowly denied on debut on soft ground at Leopardstown (7f) by Blonde Over Blue; gained compensation on next start in decisive fashion in a C&D maiden (good); saw off the fast-finishing Dancing Destiny by a head upped to Group 3 company back at Leopardstown a month ago (Blonde Over Blue fourth); likely more to come and preferred by Lordan.
runners.comment: Held off the fast-finishing Daning Destiny by a head latest, should be more to come
runners.owner: Flaxman Stables, Mrs Magnier, M Tabor, D Smith

runners.name: Ibelieveicanfly
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt in maidens, bolting up over C&D (gd-fm) in a first time hood which is retained; finished 6l behind Alpha when runner up in a C&D maiden in June (when Wayne Lordan rode); can't be discounted upped in class but this time Lordan prefers Alpha.
runners.comment: Bolted up in C&D maiden latest in first time hood, no match for Alpha over C&D in June
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Flaxman S

runners.name: Dancing Destiny
runners.spotlight: Magna Grecia filly has run five times; won her maiden on debut at Roscommon (7.5f, good); added a Listed heat at Naas (1m, good) on penultimate; flew home for a head second behind Alpha in Leopardstown Group 3 latest (7f, good); should be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: Maiden and Listed winner, closely matched with Alpha on Leopardstown running

runners.name: Blonde Over Blue
runners.spotlight: Lope De Vega filly took the scalp of Alpha on debut at Leopardstown (7f, soft); however, proved no match for that rival (or Dancing Destiny) when upped to Group 3 company back there on latest; Browne McMonagle jumps ship and tongue tie goes on now.
runners.comment: Well held behind Alpha and Dancing Destiny latest, McMonagle jumps ship; tongue tied

runners.name: Green Empress
runners.spotlight: Saxon Warrior filly is 0-2 but those two defeats were behind the top class Sun Goddess; finished 5l behind her when runner up on debut here (6f, good); closed the gap to 0.75l in the Airlie Stud Stakes back here on her second start (6f, gd-fm); the way she finished that day suggested this longer trip will suit; preferred by Browne McMonagle and an intriguing runner.
runners.comment: 0-2 but both defeats behind top class Sun Goddess, 7f looks sure to suit, interesting

races.race_name: Coolmore Stud City Of Troy Tom Cooper Irish EBF Futurity Stakes (Group 2)

runners.name: Florida Bay
runners.spotlight: Mehmas colt is the most experienced in field with four runs; career best on latest when landing the 7f Group 3 Tyros Stakes at Leopardstown; the runner up Folsom Blues finished second behind Sun Goddess in the Group 1 Phoenix Stakes on his next start; leading form claims but looks the yard's second string on rider arrangements.
runners.comment: Form of Group 3 win received big boost in the Phoenix Stakes, leading form claims

runners.name: Nola Soul
runners.spotlight: Justify colt beat subsequent Windsor Castle winner King Of Cloughan on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good) in May; made it 2-2 when landing the Listed Chesham Stakes at Royal Ascot in June (7f, gd-fm); given a two month break after that win; another big run likely on the cards.
runners.comment: Justify colt, 2-2 including Chesham Stakes on latest, given a break since, big run likely

runners.name: City Of Dubai
runners.spotlight: Mehmas colt made a winning start at Killarney last month (1m, good, Green Dreamer fifth); did well to finish a 0.75l second in Gowran Listed event latest after racing keenly; will need to settle better upped in class and dropped in trip.
runners.comment: Won on debut at Killarney, keen when second on latest, must settle better down in trip

runners.name: Nail House
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never colt landed 6f Fairyhouse maiden on debut (good); ran better than the bare result when a 4.75l fourth behind Florida Bay in the 7f Tyros Stakes at Leopardstown, denied a clear run at a crucial time; preferred by Browne McMonagle and could get closer to Florida Bay with a smoother passage.
runners.comment: Didn't get a clear run when 4.75l behind Florida Bay latest, preferred by McMonagle

runners.name: Giant Sequoia
runners.spotlight: Frankel colt was beaten at short odds over C&D (gd-yld) on debut in June but left that behind to win easily on quicker ground in a C&D maiden later that month, after which he was made favourite for the 2027 Epsom Derby; given a break since and he looks the yard's main hope on rider arrangements; likely to be thereabouts on first try in pattern company.
runners.comment: Left debut run behind to score easily over C&D in June, off since, the choice of Lordan

runners.name: Green Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Churchill colt was no match for City Of Dubai on debut at Killarney (1m, good); made all on second start in a 1m Leopardstown maiden (good) last month and the 2l runner up won a maiden next time out; should have enough pace for this shorter trip but Browne McMonagle prefers the chances of Nail House.
runners.comment: Behind City Of Dubai on debut, won 1m Leopardstown maiden latest, McMonagle deserts

races.race_name: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap

runners.name: Neo Smart
runners.spotlight: Course winner off this mark last year over 7f; zero luck in running when a close sixth over 1m here on latest; yet to run over this far a trip but her dam was a 1m4f winner so decent prospects of staying the trip; big chance if she does.
runners.comment: Traffic issues over 1m here latest, worth a go at this trip on breeding, chance if stays

runners.name: Railwayview Lady
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner for Andy Oliver last September at Navan when 125-1; narrowly denied on handicap debut on next run at Down Royal (1m5f, yielding) but lost way since and has moved yards; revival needed on stable bow; trainer form a plus.
runners.comment: Lost way since promising handicap bow, has moved to in form yard, needs to revive

runners.name: Yousaynothingatall
runners.spotlight: Generally consistent filly has run crackers in both her handicap starts, over 1m4f at Cork and over 1m2f here on latest when denied by a short head; 5lb higher now but the return to 1m4f should suit, she's preferred by Browne McMonagle and is a big player.
runners.comment: Up 5lb for short head defeat over 1m2f here latest, return to 1m4f may suit, big player

runners.name: Killyclogher Rose
runners.spotlight: Scored on handicap debut at Naas in June (1m3f, good); raised 4lb and finished last of six upped to 1m5f at Leopardstown; eased 1lb and drops back in trip; much more needed in this deeper race.
runners.comment: Last of six off revised mark at Leopardstown, eased 1lb, much more needed in better race

runners.name: Vanir
runners.spotlight: 1m4f Fairyhouse winner was 3.5l behind Yousaynothingatall over 1m2f here on her handicap debut last month; 3lb better off here so could close the gap stepped back up in distance; chance.
runners.comment: 3.5l behind Yousaynothingatall over 1m2f here latest, 3lb swing, could close that gap

runners.name: Beauparc
runners.spotlight: Below best at Dundalk last time but ran a solid race when runner up at Down Royal (1m5f, good) on her penultimate start; heavy defeat in this last year off 1lb higher and remains 5lb above last turf win.
runners.comment: Below best latest, solid run at Down Royal on penultimate, remains 5lb above last win

runners.name: My Girl Grace
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Leopardstown in June (1m2f, soft); no impact in first two handicaps on quicker ground at Killarney (11.5f) and Naas (1m3f) when 2.75l behind Letiza; eased another 3lb but may need softer conditions.
runners.comment: Maiden winner on soft, no impact in first two h'caps on quicker ground

runners.name: Marazion
runners.spotlight: 1m4f Roscommon maiden winner went close in a valuable 1m6f handicap here in May off 10lb lower; not disgraced in a 1m4f Group 3 at Cork but hiked up 6lb and beaten 11l on return to a handicap over C&D latest; bit to prove off current mark.
runners.comment: Hiked up 6lb for respectable Group 3 run, soundly beaten off revised mark here latest

runners.name: Nellcote
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut at Gowran (1m, gd-yld) and built on that upped to 12.5f when winning a Limerick fillies' maiden last month; had two subsequent winners behind that day so respected in first handicap but deserted by Browne McMonagle.
runners.comment: Limerick maiden winner, respected on handicap bow but McMonagle jumps ship

runners.name: Letiza
runners.spotlight: Two-time winner has run well on both starts since joining this yard; narrowly denied at Navan (1m2f, good) and beaten just 1.25l when a staying on fourth of 11 at Naas on latest (1m3f, good); should go well again off the same mark upped in trip.
runners.comment: Stayed on well for fourth at Naas last time, upped in trip, go well again off same mark

runners.name: Navy Waters
runners.spotlight: Both career wins came over 10.5f and 1m5f at Down Royal last season; running well in defeat this season but handicapper very slow to relent; needs to find a bit more off current mark.
runners.comment: Two-time Down Royal winner, in decent form this term, needs handicapper to relent

runners.name: Denim And Diamonds
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to Limerick maiden win (12.5f, good) last summer; step in the right direction on latest at Ballinrobe (1m5f, yielding) when a 4.75l fourth of 8; shorter trip and faster ground here a plus and rider takes off a handy 7lb; not discounted.
runners.comment: Step in right direction on latest, drop in trip and better ground to suit, not dismissed

races.race_name: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Carmers
runners.spotlight: Last year's Queen's Vase winner over this trip and beaten a little over 3l when fifth of seven in St Leger; stepped up to 2m and switched from blinkers to a visor at Down Royal in May when beating Layfayette (recd 4lb) by over 2l, with Dallas Star further back; found 2m4f and far more demanding company too much for him in the Gold Gold; softening ground at York has seen him rerouted from yesterday's Lonsdale Stakes, and this is more winnable; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Softening ground at York has seen him rerouted from there, and this is more winnable

runners.name: Queenstown
runners.spotlight: Only a maiden win to his name, but he's a smart stayer; placed in the Ebor and Irish Cesarewitch last year, and in pair of French Group 1s at the back-end; 300-day absence and will surely improve for the run.
runners.comment: Smart placed form last term, including in pair of French Group 1s; likely to need the run

runners.name: Layfayette
runners.spotlight: 11 wins in all, and seven of them at stakes level; C&D winner on heavy in April and Listed winner over extended 1m4f on soft at Limerick in June; held in Leopardstown Group 3 on quicker ground last time; second to Carmers over 2m at Down Royal back in May and now 4lb worse off.
runners.comment: Admirable 9yo; second to Carmers over 2m at Down Royal back in May and now 4lb worse off

runners.name: Kizlyar
runners.spotlight: Rated 6lb below stablemate, and last year's winner, Leinster but is on a roll and the champion jockey prefers his chance; hurdling during the winter; won a Killarney conditions event over this trip in May which, remarkably, produced three of the first four home in the Ascot Stakes (2m4f), which he won grittily off 92.
runners.comment: Battling winner of Ascot Stakes (2m4f) off 92 and champion jockey's choice over Leinster

runners.name: Asakir
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner over 1m2f at Leopardstown; second to Limestone in 1m5f Listed contest at Navan in May; couple of lengths further behind taht rival when Limestone followed up in Queen's Vase at Royal Ascot, where quicker ground may not have suited.
runners.comment: Listed second at Navan, but finished further behind the winner in the Queen's Vase
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Dallas Star
runners.spotlight: Well-beaten second to Leinster in weaker four-runner renewal of this last year, and no match for Carmers at Down Royal in May; on a long losing sequence and will be a big price; usually leads.
runners.comment: Well-beaten second to Leinster last year; on a long losing sequence, usually leads

runners.name: Leinster
runners.spotlight: Readily beat Dallas Star in last year's weaker renewal, but was tailed off in Irish St Leger; respectable runs behind top stayer Scandinavia on goodish ground first two starts this term; well beaten on soft behind Layfayette in June; overlooked by stable jockey; tongue-tie goes on.
runners.comment: Readily beat Dallas Star in last year's weaker renewal; overlooked by stable jockey

races.race_name: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap

runners.name: Ocean Echo
runners.spotlight: Runner up in a 7f Cork maiden on testing ground back in May; okay effort on handicap debut at Leopardstown in June (1m, good) but unplaced in a rated race and a maiden last twice; new tongue tie needs to eke out more.
runners.comment: Unplaced in a rated race and maiden last twice, tongue tie must eke out more
runners.owner: R Scahill, S Begley, J & C Bourke

runners.name: Are You In Or Out
runners.spotlight: Won off 1lb lower on seasonal return at Fairyhouse (6f, good); below best in three runs since and was slowly away when midfield at Navan on latest; needs a revival.
runners.comment: Lost form since Fairyhouse win in May, slowly away at Navan latest, revival needed

runners.name: Treasured Royal
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner ran a fine race in a Naas 3yo premier handicap (6f, good) in May off 6lb higher mostly modest form since; below par at Bellewstown last time but yard hitting form and can't discount in new headgear.
runners.comment: Fine run at Naas in May hasn't been built on but yard hitting form, new headgear tried

runners.name: Caislean Ni Cuan
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in 7f maidens; similar story on handicap debut over C&D 13 days ago when down the field behind Mint Man; eased 3lb but much more needed.
runners.comment: Modest form in 7f maidens and on h'cap bow over C&D latest, needs more off 3lb lower

runners.name: Battleforsupremacy
runners.spotlight: Showed little in four turf maidens last year but won on handicap debut at Dundalk in November; good third over that C&D when last seen in February; probably best watched on return to turf unless the market speaks.
runners.comment: AW winner, good run at Dundalk when last seen in February, watch unless market speaks

runners.name: Platino Bianco
runners.spotlight: Won off basement mark at Naas (5f, good) in June; running okay without threatening to win in three starts since; 6f fine but 2lb wrong here and others preferred.
runners.comment: Won over 5f at Naas in June, okay form since, 6f fine but 2lb wrong here, others preferred

runners.name: Clonmacash
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins this year during a busy campaign; sole turf win came here over 5f a year ago but below best in recent starts and remains 8lb above that last success.
runners.comment: Won over 5f here a year ago off 8lb lower, below best in recent starts

runners.name: Chester Nimitz
runners.spotlight: Hasn't really fired so far this season but has been running over 7f-1m; blinkers added to tongue tie worn last time and drops back to trip he won his maiden over; not dismissed for yard coming into form.
runners.comment: Below best at 7f-1m this term, won maiden at this trip, blinkers added, not dismissed

runners.name: Cashel Blue
runners.spotlight: Won on handicap debut at Down Royal in May (5f, good) off 6lb lower; fine effort off revised mark at Navan over 5f (good); below that level at Cork latest (5f, good) but step up to 6f could unlock further improvement; chance.
runners.comment: In good form over 5f since tackling handicaps, step up to 6f could suit, chance

runners.name: Irish Rumour
runners.spotlight: On long losing run but did shape well over extended 6f here (yielding) in June off 1lb lower; needs to bounce back from a moderate run over 7f at Naas last time.
runners.comment: Shaped well over 6.5f here in June, must bounce back from moderate Naas run on latest

runners.name: De Songbird
runners.spotlight: Maiden yet to display winning potential; seventh in first two handicaps at Leopardstown and Killarney, both over 1m; drops in trip and cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Maiden, seventh in first two h'caps over 1m, drops in trip, cheekpieces tried

runners.name: Four Blondes
runners.spotlight: 1-21 but has finished runner up on five occasions; hasn't built on promising seasonal return over C&D but is lurking on a dangerous mark if rediscovering her best.
runners.comment: 1-21, below best last twice, lurking on dangerous mark if rediscovers best

runners.name: Mint Man
runners.spotlight: Regained the winning thread over C&D two weeks ago when wearing this headgear combination for the first time; has gone up 6lb but rider's 7lb claim negates that; should give another good account.
runners.comment: Up 6lb for C&D win two weeks ago, rider takes off 7lb, should go well again

runners.name: Bold Optimist
runners.spotlight: Two-time winner has posted solid back-to-back efforts over 5f at Naas and here last week (short head behind Soulful Diva); return to 6f looks a plus and place claims at least again off unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Fine runs over 5f last twice, return to 6f looks a plus, place claims again off same mark

runners.name: Lady Landhort
runners.spotlight: First reserve; AW winner is 0-6 on turf and has yet to trouble the judge; well beaten behind a few of these over 5f here on latest and 9lb wrong.
runners.comment: Well beaten behind a few of these over 5f here latest, 9lb wrong; reserve
runners.owner: T J Flanagan & Ronan Macken & Shane McSweeney & S O'Malley

runners.name: Glasarmi
runners.spotlight: Definite ability in maidens at 7f-1m on yielding and soft ground; drop back to 6f could suit on handicap debut; faster ground a query but market check advised.
runners.comment: Promise in maidens at 7f-1m on easy ground, worth a market check on h'cap bow
runners.owner: P R Dowling & Ms G Brennan

runners.name: Coincidental Glory
runners.spotlight: AW winner is 0-14 on turf but has run well in defeat at times; below best over 7f at Galway on latest but fine run on penultimate start over 6f at Navan (Poweraccclaim 1.25l behind); thereabouts if repeating that.
runners.comment: Below best over 7f at Galway, second over 6f at Naas penultimate, big chance on that run

runners.name: Absoluteassignment
runners.spotlight: Promising start in handicaps when a 1.25l second at Fairyhouse (6f, good) but soundly beaten twice since; new headgear combination needs to spark.
runners.comment: Below par twice since promising handicap debut, new headgear combo needs to spark

runners.name: Soulful Diva
runners.spotlight: Started the season slowly but back on song with a fine run here 6 days ago, running on well for a 1.25l second; same mark here and worth another go at 6f on the evidence of that last run; chance.
runners.comment: Good run over 5f here last week, same mark now, worth another go over 6f

runners.name: Beat The Devil
runners.spotlight: Best form is on the AW but was only 2l behind Mint Man over C&D on latest, his first try over 6f; could sneak into the money off the same mark with a repeat.
runners.comment: Just 2l behind Mint Man over C&D latest, could sneak into the money with a repeat

runners.name: Rosato
runners.spotlight: Narrowly denied off 4lb lower at Cork on penultimate (6f, gd-fm) when coming from the back; weakened behind Mint Man here on latest when ridden more positively; cheekpieces go on now.
runners.comment: Fine effort at Cork on penultimate, didn't back it up over C&D latest, cheekpieces on

runners.name: Hugo's Girl
runners.spotlight: Maiden has been knocking on the door and went close again over C&D last time when a 0.5l second behind Mint Man; nudged up 1lb for that but has to be on the shortlist in current form.
runners.comment: Maiden, another fine run here last time behind Mint Man, go well again off 1lb higher

runners.name: Caffu Zafeen
runners.spotlight: Failed to win in Britain and not much encouragement to take from three runs for this stable; too keen at Naas on latest and others look more convincing.
runners.comment: Failed to win in Britain, no impact in three runs for this yard, others more convincing

runners.name: Unidos
runners.spotlight: Took a step forward from previous form when running on late for a 3.25l fifth of 15 at Fairyhouse (7f, good) last time; mark unchanged but not sure this drop in trip will suit on the evidence of that last effort.
runners.comment: Ran on well over 7f at Fairyhouse last time, mark unchanged, shorter trip a query

runners.name: Kiss Don't Tell
runners.spotlight: Promise in AW maiden over 5f in December; no impact on handicap debut and seasonal return at Cork (5f, good) 8 days ago; eased 1lb and moves up in trip now; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on h'cap bow/seasonal return at Cork, eased 1lb and upped in trip

runners.name: Cladach
runners.spotlight: Hasn't shown a whole lot in maidens and not obviously well treated for handicap debut but with a top yard and bred to win races; could take a step forward; check the market.
runners.comment: Modest form in maidens, not obviously well treated but could improve, check market

runners.name: Pinar Del Rio
runners.spotlight: Best run yet for this yard a 1.25l fifth of 13 over 6f at Naas when last sighted in May; 2lb lower now and has won twice over C&D but all three career wins on soft and heavy ground; rain would boost claims.
runners.comment: Close fifth at Naas when last seen in May, dual C&D winner is best on softer ground

races.race_name: Nags Head Cutting British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Walkin On The Moon
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far in good-quality 7f races on first two starts, shaping with significant promise before fading into midfield in valuable Glorious Goodwood maiden (good to firm) on latter occasion; drops in trip here; must be considered.
runners.comment: Shaped well before fading into midfield in valuable Glorious Goodwood maiden this month

runners.name: One For Bruce
runners.spotlight: 90,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners South Seas (6f/7f 2yo including Group 3; RPR 108) and Long Ago (1m-1m3f including 2yo; 106); dam maiden half-sister to 7f 2yo/Hong Kong 1m1f Listed winner Zaidan; no surprise if he features on debut.
runners.comment: 90,000gns yearling; half-brother to a Group 3 winner; no surprise if he features

runners.name: Sky Symphony
runners.spotlight: 14,000gns foal; 13th foal; half-brother to ten winners including Mr Swivell (1m/8.6f; RPR 102), Up Above (5f 2yo; 94), Thora Barber (6f/6.5f including 2yo; 88) and New Heights (7f 2yo-1m2f; 84); dam unraced; stable not known for winning newcomers.
runners.comment: From a good family but stable not known for winning newcomers

runners.name: Blue Fox
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam twice-raced sister to 7f/1m winner Forest Maiden, half-sister to winners Loxley (1m4f/12.5f Group 2) and Will Scarlet (useful 7f-1m4f), out of 1m2f Group 1 winner; already gelded; considered only if lively in the betting.
runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to a middle-distance Group 2 winner; may be a longer-term project

runners.name: Great Balls O'Fire
runners.spotlight: 135,000gns yearling; 11th foal; closely related to a US 5.5f winner, half-brother to winners Flash Gordon (6f; RPR 102), Umm Hurair (8.6f AW; 98), Sunset Dream (7f/1m AW; 89) and Haazeez (6f AW; 85); dam 7f 2yo winner (78); market helpful, particularly in relation to connections' other runner Walkin On The Moon.
runners.comment: 135,000gns yearling; market helpful, particularly in relation to connections' other runner

runners.name: Silent Sadhu
runners.spotlight: Well beaten after racing too freely in valuable Ascot maiden last month but was promising sixth of 18 on debut at Newbury (also 6f, good to firm) a fortnight earlier and still has scope to build on that performance.
runners.comment: Well beaten after racing too freely last time but may yet build upon his promising debut

races.race_name: Twyford Down Cutting Handicap

runners.name: Royal Accord
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last August off this mark when with Stuart Williams; however, pretty much tailed off in this season's races.
runners.comment: C&D winner last August but pretty much tailed off in this season's races

runners.name: Sword
runners.spotlight: Dual winner; 0-5 for Stuart Williams but had been holding his own in 7f handicaps until a lesser show last time; whether he's quick enough for 6f is the glaring concern (all 23 runs from 7f to 1m2f).
runners.comment: Had been holding her own in 7f handicaps until a lesser show last time; first run at 6f

runners.name: Rajaking
runners.spotlight: Doing well for his new yard and nicely on top at the finish in a big field at York a month ago (6f, good to firm); up 5lb but looks a big player.
runners.comment: Doing well for his new yard and nicely on top at the finish in a big field at York

runners.name: Spring Bloom
runners.spotlight: In-form 9yo whose last four runs have been over C&D; failed narrowly under a penalty two weeks ago (behind Fifty Nifty) but 1lb lower here and should be involved.
runners.comment: In-form 9yo whose last four runs have been over C&D; 1lb lower than close third latest

runners.name: Sea Cookie
runners.spotlight: Won a Newbury maiden and followed up in a C&D handicap in June off 4lb lower; down the field at the July meeting and raced freely when no match for the winner in a small field at Leicester; remains open to improvement and a tongue-tie is added.
runners.comment: C&D winner; remains open to improvement and a tongue-tie is added

runners.name: Expert Agent
runners.spotlight: Won on the Rowley Mile in May (6f, good; 4lb lower) and last time finished sixth of 26 at Glorious Goodwood, which wasn't a bad run; usually ridden from behind so needs a strong pace which he might get.
runners.comment: 6th of 26 at Goodwood; usually ridden from behind so needs a good pace which he might get
runners.owner: J P Morris, Mrs V A Tunnicliffe Et Al

runners.name: Juan Les Pins
runners.spotlight: Had been running well but has performed miserably in his last two races when awkward at the start both times.
runners.comment: Has performed miserably in his last two races when awkward at the start both times

runners.name: Back To Me
runners.spotlight: 6f AW maiden winner in Ireland and won a 7f AW novice for Ben Haslam in April; went close in one of his three subsequent handicaps and that was over 6f; sold in July for 47,000gns; not dismissed.
runners.comment: Bought in July for 47,000gns and not without hope on best form; still lightly raced

runners.name: Pilu
runners.spotlight: Can leads; dual winner at two; below best over 5f at Goodwood last time but had been running well in 6f handicaps and those were stronger races; stall 1 might not be ideal but enters the reckoning.
runners.comment: Solid form in 6f handicaps this season (last run was at 5f) and this is a drop in grade

runners.name: Fifty Nifty
runners.spotlight: Has won over 1m but recent efforts at 6f and after his C&D win he fared best of those held up when third last week; this could pan out more favourably for him.
runners.comment: After his C&D win he fared best of those held up when third last week

runners.name: Photosynthesis
runners.spotlight: Signed off last season with a head success off this mark on the Rowley Mile (6f, good); he appeared to be running into form before the new cheekpieces backfired at Doncaster; makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Appeared to be running into form before the new cheekpieces backfired at Doncaster

runners.name: Zoulu Chief
runners.spotlight: All four wins at 6f and not on an impossible mark even with top weight; however, he's not easily trusted after his last two efforts.
runners.comment: Capable 6f handicapper but he's not easily trusted after his last two efforts

runners.name: Archduke Ferdinand
runners.spotlight: Went close over C&D last week in a race he won two years earlier; now 3lb higher and they claimed 5lb last time, so may need more.
runners.comment: 3lb higher than when second here last week and they claimed 5lb that day

races.race_name: Hargreaves Services PLC Handicap

runners.name: Khuskhas
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with C&D (good to firm) win for James Ferguson in June and was respectable fourth at Windsor (1m, good to firm) on last month's first run for Tom Clover; tends to face a bit too freely so it will be interesting to see whether switch from blinkers to a first-time hood pay dividends.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June and last month's Windsor fourth was respectable; headgear switched

runners.name: Karakula Dancer
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner for James Ferguson in early part of this year and placed on both subsequent turf starts (1m, good to firm/good); didn't fire on Tapeta last month but makes stable debut from a workable mark.
runners.comment: Didn't fire on Tapeta last month but makes stable debut from a workable mark

runners.name: Royal Bodyguard
runners.spotlight: Sometimes races a bit too freely but ran well before fading into fourth over C&D (good) in June and returns here after keeping on well for second in tactical race at Ffos Las (1m, good) ten days ago; still on a workable mark; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Ran well over C&D in June and returns here after another good effort ten days ago

runners.name: Guest House
runners.spotlight: Kept on well for clearcut success in six-runner race at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, his second win over that C&D this season; moves back up from Class 6 after a 6lb rise but is evidently in good nick.
runners.comment: Up 6lb for Class 6 win at Yarmouth this month but evidently in good nick

runners.name: Napolian
runners.spotlight: Has mixed record this season but won a match race in June and was seemingly aided by a first-time hood when very close second at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) a week ago; on the premises if in the right mood again.
runners.comment: Inconsistent this season but went close in first-time hood at Doncaster a week ago

runners.name: La Mariposa
runners.spotlight: Outran 33-1 odds when second of six in slowly run C&D (good to firm) novice last month, her third start, but the value of that form is open to question and she was remote when last of four over 1m2f here three weeks ago.
runners.comment: Form of last month's C&D second looks a bit iffy; well beaten over 1m2f since
runners.owner: L J Vaessen And Stephen Barber

runners.name: Forever Endless
runners.spotlight: Showed only minor promise in his three qualifying races (7f-8.3f) and is not obviously well treated for this handicap debut but remains unexposed; worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: Showed only minor promise in qualifying races but is worth market check on handicap debut

races.race_name: Hopeful Stakes (Sponsored By Blackwell Earthmoving) (Listed Race)

runners.name: Elarak
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who finished close up in valuable 7f handicaps at Royal Ascot and here (both good to firm) on last two appearances; doesn't have that much to find with the principals on this return to Listed company but has never run in a sprint before.
runners.comment: Close up in valuable 7f handicaps on last two outings; this is his first run in a sprint

runners.name: Dubai Bling
runners.spotlight: Led close home to win valuable 5f Ascot handicap in July and wasn't beaten far when back over 6f for Stewards' Cup at Glorious Goodwood (also good to firm) at start of this month; didn't fire at York (5.3f, good) on Wednesday, though, and needs a personal best here.
runners.comment: Won valuable 5f handicap last month but didn't fire at York this week; new PB needed

runners.name: Prince Of India
runners.spotlight: Yet to win this season but took his form to a new level when fitted with blinkers for last two runs, looking unlucky not to finish closer than sixth in C&D Group 1 July Cup before running on well for second in 7f Newbury Group 2 (also good to firm) last Saturday; eased in grade today; the one to beat.
runners.comment: Unlucky not to finish closer than sixth in C&D Group 1 July Cup; the one to beat

runners.name: Words Of Truth
runners.spotlight: Won 6f Group 2 as a 2yo (good to soft) and scored in this grade at Sandown (5f, good) in June, after a break; carries 3lb penalty in stronger race today but could still have untapped potential back over this longer trip; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Won 5f Sandown Listed race in June and could still have potential over 6f

runners.name: Quinault
runners.spotlight: 12-time winner, including 2024 edition of this race; has a bit to prove after two down-the-field finishes but faced tough task in Group 1 July Cup here last time and he looked as good as ever when creditable third in Group 3 on Rowley Mile here (6f, good) in April; in the shake-up if back on song.
runners.comment: Has a bit to prove after two down-the-field runs but will be in shake-up if back on song

runners.name: Caburn
runners.spotlight: Kept on for Listed third at Doncaster (6f, good to soft) in March and was denied clear run when respectable sixth in Newcastle handicap (6f, AW) on latest outing in June but appears to face a tough assignment here.
runners.comment: Placed in Doncaster Listed race in March but faces a tough assignment here

runners.name: Midnight Tango
runners.spotlight: Belied 66-1 odds when close second in Ascot Group 3 (6f, good to firm) on seasonal debut in May and subsequent Group 1 defeat over that C&D at Royal meeting is not viewed too harshly; may yet have a bigger run in her but others in this field have more convincing profiles.
runners.comment: Close second at big odds in Ascot Group 3 in May but others here are more convincing

races.race_name: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Night In Vegas
runners.spotlight: Began career with two 6f wins and has performed admirably well in two subsequent 6f Group 2s, finishing fifth in Coventry at Royal Ascot and third in Richmond at Glorious Goodwood; the class act in this line-up.
runners.comment: Performed admirably well in 6f Group 2s on last two outings; the class act in this line-up

runners.name: Zigazig Ah
runners.spotlight: Just prevailed in Newbury's valuable Super Sprint last month, her third start, and was not discredited in good-quality conditions race at Glorious Goodwood (also 5f, good to firm) a few days later; should be okay back at 6f and has a fighting chance on these terms.
runners.comment: Won Newbury's valuable Super Sprint last month and has fighting chance on these terms

runners.name: A Bear Affair
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to debut win in March and was below form on latest outing but wasn't beaten far when sixth in Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm), and subsequently went close in a 5f Sandown Listed race (good); each-way claims at least if back on song.
runners.comment: Below form last time but went close in 5f Listed race two runs ago; e-w claims at least
runners.owner: A Bit On The Side & Partner

runners.name: Ron's Angel
runners.spotlight: Beat subsequent Super Sprint winner Zigazig Ah when winning Lingfield maiden (6f, AW) in June and was close second in five-runner nursery there (6f, good to firm) last month; can collect some prize-money.
runners.comment: Close second in five-runner Lingfield nursery last month; can collect some prize-money

runners.name: Topaz
runners.spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise when making all to justify skinny odds on five-runner Salisbury novice (6f, good to firm) last month, her fourth run; contests much deeper race here but not ruled out each-way.
runners.comment: Justified skinny odds on Salisbury novice last month; not ruled out each-way

runners.name: Leucothea
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who was about 10l behind Zigazig Ah when 18th in Newbury's Super Sprint (5f, good to firm) last month; fared better when close second in recent 6f nursery but faces a tougher task here.
runners.comment: Won close in recent 6f nursery but faces tougher task here

runners.name: Baddaddan
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise on last month's debut at Newbury and was too good for useful rival in three-runner contest at Nottingham (also 6f, good to firm) 11 days ago; this is tougher but he's well bred and remains unexposed.
runners.comment: Beat useful rival in small field 11 days ago; well bred and remains unexposed; a possible

runners.name: Mojito Madness
runners.spotlight: Improving colt who made all for clearcut success in 7f Redcar maiden (good to firm) last month, his third start; needs to make further progress here but that's possible if the drop in trip suits.
runners.comment: Made all in 7f Redcar maiden last month; might progress again if drop to 6f suits

runners.name: Lady Rosalind
runners.spotlight: Reportedly unsuited by good to firm ground when disappointing favourite at Windsor last month and will be hoping for some rain here but won Ripon novice (6f, good) two runs ago and still has potential for top stable.
runners.comment: Disappointing favourite last time (fast ground blamed); can still build upon Ripon win

runners.name: Supreme Star
runners.spotlight: Made bold bid from the front when clear second to useful rival in Nottingham maiden (6f, good to firm) last month but was below that form when well-held second on AW a fortnight later; others look stronger.
runners.comment: Made bold bid from the front on penultimate outing but others look stronger here

runners.name: Red Blue Point
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when second on debut at Thirsk (5f, good) three weeks ago, form that was given good boost when winner came second in big-field sales race at York on Thursday; needs improvement here but has the potential.
runners.comment: Second on debut at Thirsk; winner came second in big-field sales race at York on Thursday

runners.name: Proper Naughty
runners.spotlight: Out of a well-connected French 7f winner; beaten under 1l when third on debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago and, although that was just a run-of-the-mill contest, she's open to significant improvement.
runners.comment: Beaten under 1l on recent debut at Windsor and open to significant improvement

runners.name: Baldetti
runners.spotlight: Placed on first two starts, losing out only by a neck at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) on second occasion; that form is below the standard required here, though, and he disappointed on his latest outing (albeit hampered).
runners.comment: Went close at Pontefract two runs ago but that form is below the standard required here
runners.owner: G H Thompson And Michael Dods

runners.name: Tallahassee Lassie
runners.spotlight: Came good in Class 6 nursery at Ffos Las (5f, good) last month, her fourth run, but has since run poorly over 6f in that grade.
runners.comment: Won Class 6 nursery last month but well beaten in that grade since

runners.name: Everatease
runners.spotlight: Won two quite valuable sellers (both 6f, good) this spring and looked unlucky when very close second in recent Windsor nursery (6f, good to firm); more exposed than most of these but ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Looked unlucky not to win recent Windsor nursery; can give another good account here

runners.name: Frumoasa
runners.spotlight: Out of a Listed 6f 2yo winner; overcame inexperience to make winning debut at Southwell (5f, AW) in April and also ran well when third at Kempton (6f, AW) the following month; remains open to improvement but this turf debut comes after a three-month break.
runners.comment: Launched career with two good AW runs in the spring; makes turf debut after 94-day break

runners.name: Chief Minister
runners.spotlight: Bettered low-key debut and was only beaten about 2l when fifth of eight in Pontefract maiden (6f, good to firm) this month but needs to take another big step forward here.
runners.comment: Second run was better than his debut but another big step forward is needed

runners.name: Conciliate
runners.spotlight: Creditable third at York in June and battled well to pip odds-on newcomer in four-runner Ayr maiden (also 6f, good) last month; might still have more to offer but is not really favoured by these terms.
runners.comment: Battled well to win four-runner maiden last month; not really favoured by these terms

runners.name: Polgaria
runners.spotlight: Lowly rated maiden who would be a shock winner of this.
runners.comment: Lowly rated maiden who would be a shock winner of this

runners.name: Issy's Gift
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a Group-placed 2yo winner but managed only ninth of 12 on debut at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) in May and needs to have made huge progress during subsequent three-month break.
runners.comment: Only ninth of 12 on debut at Chepstow in May and not seen since

races.race_name: Blackwell Earthmoving 70th Anniversary Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Sixpack
runners.spotlight: Three wins this season (1m4f-1m6f); bounced back from poor AW run when close second to Arqoob here (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago and might still have a bigger performance in him over this longer trip; respected.
runners.comment: Three wins this season; close second to Arqoob here (1m4f) last time; 1m6f also suits

runners.name: Goblet Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Landed big prize over this trip on Rowley Mile (good to firm) on 1,000 Guineas day in May and was close third in another heritage handicap over C&D (good to firm) when reappearing last month; nudged up only 2lb for that and in much calmer waters today; good chance.
runners.comment: Close third in valuable C&D contest last month and only 2lb higher in this easier race

runners.name: Pearl River
runners.spotlight: Still 6lb higher than for emphatic win at York (extended 1m2f, good) in May but ran well when fifth of 13 at Glorious Goodwood (1m3f, good to firm); not out of this if suited by the new trip (first run beyond 1m4f).
runners.comment: Ran well over 1m3f at Gorious Goodwood last month; tries a new trip here

runners.name: Bulletin
runners.spotlight: In the frame all six starts this season, and might have bumped into a smart one when second off today's mark at Kempton (1m4f, AW) ten days ago; also suited by turf and won't be far away if stamina holds out over new trip.
runners.comment: Consistent over middle distances this season; won't be far away if stamina holds out here

runners.name: Arqoob
runners.spotlight: Won this race comfortably in first-time blinkers a year ago and looked back in prime form when keeping on well to beat Sixpack here (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; only 2lb higher today; has another big role to play.
runners.comment: Won this in 2025 and was back in prime form over 1m4f here last month; contender

races.race_name: Polhill Cutting Handicap

runners.name: Tiva
runners.spotlight: Led close home to win this race a year ago (good to firm) and was back on the scoresheet with another narrow success at Musselburgh (5f, good) a fortnight ago; likely contender.
runners.comment: Won this in 2025 and was back on the scoresheet at Musselburgh recently; likely contender

runners.name: Diomed Duke
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent 4yo who won readily under Olivia Haines at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) last month; 5lb higher in a higher-grade race here but ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Consistent 4yo; up 5lb for last month's ready Lingfield win under Olivia Haines

runners.name: Fantasy Master
runners.spotlight: Disappointed when dropped back to 5f in June and absent for ten weeks since but was commendable third of 18 on seasonal debut at Ascot (6f, good to firm) in May and is now 1lb lower; player if back on song.
runners.comment: Disappointed when dropped back to 5f last time but ran big race over 6f beforehand

runners.name: Lara Antipova
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage filly who kept on well for second when dropped to 5f at Ascot (good to firm) last month, her second handicap; will be a potent threat off same mark here if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.
runners.comment: Low-mileage filly; creditable second when dropped to 5f at Ascot in July; cheekpieces on
runners.owner: Moulton Racing And Mrs A Jordan

runners.name: Beauzon
runners.spotlight: Won seven in a row over 6f on AW at start of this year but has returned from a break with three down-the-field turf runs, the latest here (6f, good to firm) eight days ago.
runners.comment: Won seven in a row on AW at start of this year but badly out of form on turf lately

runners.name: Maelstrom
runners.spotlight: Completed 6f hat-trick for William Haggas in spring 2025; midfield on both starts for new stable this summer but looked unlucky not to finish close to the target here (6f, good to firm; denied clear run) a week ago and has possibilities if suited by this drop in trip.
runners.comment: Denied clear run over 6f here a week ago; a possible if this drop in trip suits

runners.name: Aspull
runners.spotlight: Left Clive Cox after beginning this campaign with two poor runs (1m/7f), and there has been no upturn after two starts for new stable (6f/7f); drops to 5f with huge amount to prove.
runners.comment: Seems badly to have lost his way this year; drops in trip with lots to prove

races.race_name: ML Lynch Civil Engineering Ltd. Maiden Hurdle (Div I)

runners.name: Minella Hollow
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner in 2024; two runs last year were solid and beaten 16l at Roscommon (2m, yielding) 18 days ago after ten months off; entitled to come on for that but others still open to more progress.
runners.comment: Dual bumper winner; hurdle runs solid, will come on for lto; vulnerable to unexposed ones

runners.name: Papanell
runners.spotlight: Showed ability when fourth and third in two decent bumpers last year; struggled on soft ground on hurdles debut in February; off since and others preferred.
runners.comment: Showed ability in bumpers; struggled in soft on hurdles debut in Feb; others preferred

runners.name: Airds Moss
runners.spotlight: Placed in point, promising debut when second in Cork bumper (2m3f, yielding); went one better in nice style at this track 103 days ago, going comfortably 3.25l clear; form probably not great but she clearly has ability and is interesting on hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Looked potentially useful in two bumpers, won here easily; interesting hurdle debutant

runners.name: Well Bud
runners.spotlight: Finished 11l adrift of Airds Moss on debut here in May in a bumper; bit below that when seventh at same venue last month; yard won this last year but hard to see him following up.
runners.comment: Well-beat by Airds Moss on debut; bit below that latest; hard to see him improving enough

runners.name: Market Square
runners.spotlight: Showed promise when fifth at Punchestown on debut but easy to back and took a step backwards at Galway last time; bit to prove now going hurdling.
runners.comment: Promise on debut at Punchestown; step backwards at Galway latest; bit to prove now

runners.name: Kingstonian
runners.spotlight: Sole win in nine Flat starts came in 1m4f (good) maiden at Tramore a year ago; gambled on, narrow 0.75l second on stable debut in Chester Plate in May off 86; ran to similar level at Galway last time; could be a nice hurdling prospect.
runners.comment: Smart Flat handicapper, second in Chester Plate in May; could be a nice hurdling prospect

runners.name: Kilbeg Jimmy
runners.spotlight: Malinas gelding; 25,000euros 3yo; half-brother to winners Little Mixup (2m hurdle) and Peacenik (useful 2m-3m hurdle); dam unraced close relative of smart 2m-3m hurdle winner Kilfenora, out of useful bumper/2m-2m2f hurdle winner; decent pedigree but this is a hot race on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to two hurdle winners; decent pedigree but tough ask in hot race on debut
runners.owner: K Power & D Power & Alan Daly & Bernard Troy

runners.name: Man Down
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; pulled up on third point-to-point start in May; up against it on rules debut.
runners.comment: Third reserve; pulled up on third point-to-point start in May; up against it

runners.name: Local Resident
runners.spotlight: Shirocoo gelding; 4,000euros foal; closely related to point winner Fiddaun, half-brother to winners Brandt (2m6f/3m4f chase) and Kilbrew Boy (2m4f hurdle/chase); dam unraced half-sister to 7f Flat/2m hurdle winner Bula Rose; second in sole point-to-point outing in March; yard did well with brother.
runners.comment: Half-brother to yard's hurdle and chase winner Brandt; second in point; makes debut

runners.name: Misty Valentine
runners.spotlight: No reason to recommend in two starts; can't make a case for.
runners.comment: No reason to recommend in two starts; can't make a case for

runners.name: Reaching High
runners.spotlight: AW Flat handicap winner in Britain over 1m6f; ran three times for this stable, second at Leopardstown off 92 before luckless run in Ascot Stakes; returned after 12 months off in same race last time and ran too bad to be true; very useful staying handicapper and fascinating recruit to hurdling for top jumps stable; should stay well.
runners.comment: Smart staying Flat handicapper; top jumps stable; should stay well and fascinating runner
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: The Orphan Girl
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at Tramore last time; needs another run for a mark.
runners.comment: Tailed off at Tramore last time; needs another run for a mark

runners.name: Sea Limit
runners.spotlight: Beaten 69l on debut; unlikely to figure.
runners.comment: Beaten 69l on debut; unlikely to figure

runners.name: Windy Grey
runners.spotlight: Yet to show anything in three starts; readily passed over.
runners.comment: Yet to show anything in three starts; readily passed over

runners.name: Individualism
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner in Britain (rated 80); fair enough effort on stable debut over C&D in May; last of seven on the Flat 39 days ago, however; up against it.
runners.comment: Ran okay on stable debut over C&D in May but poor on latest Flat outing; up against it

runners.name: Rockstar Rebel
runners.spotlight: Beaten out of sight on debut; can't fancy.
runners.comment: Beaten out of sight on debut; can't fancy

races.race_name: ML Lynch Civil Engineering Ltd. Maiden Hurdle (Div II)

runners.name: Minella Moon Shine
runners.spotlight: Set to run a big race on point-to-point debut in 2024 before falling; returned after long absence when neck second to Like An Ocean at Roscommon last month; disappointed up in trip on softer ground 18 days ago; bit to find with principals.
runners.comment: Travelled well when second on debut; step backwards lto; form a bit below principals

runners.name: Golden Handshake
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner on good-to-firm in Britain; likely to have finished second but for unseating at the last at Galway on hurdles debut 21 days ago; that rates strong form so a similar effort could be good enough.
runners.comment: Likely to finish second at Galway lto on hurdles debut before fell; big chance with repeat

runners.name: Cast A Cold Eye
runners.spotlight: First reserve; half-sister to Champion Bumper winner Bambino Fever for same stable; beaten 13l in pair of bumpers; improvement can be expected over hurdles for top yard, but needs to take a fair step forward.
runners.comment: First reserve; beaten 13l in pair of bumpers; improvement can be expected over hurdles

runners.name: Ealu Tapa
runners.spotlight: Mid-division on debut in Punchestown bumper, but improved plenty at Ballinrobe when running out a ready 4.75l winner; form hasn't worked out yet, but he was impressive and is an interesting hurdling debutant.
runners.comment: Improved plenty for debut to run out ready winner of Ballinrobe bumper; hurdles bow

runners.name: Marilyns Poet
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on debut 14 days ago; no reason to fancy.
runners.comment: Tailed off on debut 14 days ago; no reason to fancy

runners.name: Macoo
runners.spotlight: Ocovango gelding; dam 2m6f chase/3m hurdle winner; makes belated debut and best watched.
runners.comment: Ocovango gelding; dam 2m6f chase/3m hurdle winner; makes belated debut and best watched

runners.name: Le Vent d'Ex
runners.spotlight: Nothing in first to runs to suggest that he can win a maiden hurdle.
runners.comment: Nothing to suggest he can win a maiden on first two runs

runners.name: Je Suis Celebre
runners.spotlight: Massaat gelding; 8,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Cape Coast (1m4f/1m6f; RPR 98), Conundrum (1m/1m2f Flat, 81; 2m hurdle) and Annie Agnew (2m1f hurdle); dam Italian Listed-placed 7.5f-1m3f winner (inc 2yo; 101), half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Fanunalter; one of two for stable and first string; market can guide.
runners.comment: Massaat gelding; half-brother to two hurdle winners; one of two for yard

runners.name: Certosa
runners.spotlight: Reasonable runs at Limerick over hurdles and in a Thurles bumper but overall form suggests she's not up to winning this.
runners.comment: Has reached just a fair level in seven starts; fell at first lto; needs big improvement

runners.name: Champagne Diamond
runners.spotlight: Little to suggest he can win this based on two hurdle runs; well behind Sea Eagle last time; tongue-tie tried.
runners.comment: Well behind Sea Eagle at Wexford lto; plenty to find

runners.name: Ikalimix
runners.spotlight: Rated 95 after four hurdle runs; unlikely to be good enough to feature here.
runners.comment: Rated 95 after four hurdle runs; unlikely to be good enough to feature here

runners.name: Kauto Empress
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way both hurdle starts; one for handicaps
runners.comment: Beaten a long way both starts; one for handicaps

runners.name: Lincoln Mill
runners.spotlight: Moderate hurdles debut, set to finish way behind Golden Handshake; unlikely contender.
runners.comment: Moderate hurdles debut, set to finish way behind Golden Handshake; unlikely contender

runners.name: Deeter
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on debut in bumper 163 days ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Pulled up on debut in bumper 163 days ago; others preferred

runners.name: Molto Amichi
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 14 starts on Flat came here over 1m on good last month off 75; set to finish a decent third on hurdles debut at Tipperary in October; that form entitles him to be considered.
runners.comment: Course winner on the Flat; about to be decent third on hurdles debut in Oct; not out of it

runners.name: Approval
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner in Britain on good-to-firm; improved on moderate hurdles debut when beaten 17l at Listowel on good 84 days ago having raced plenty keen; each-way claims if building on that.
runners.comment: Keen but much improved from hurdles debut at Listowel; ew chance if building

races.race_name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Uptaurintop
runners.spotlight: Maiden who has some decent placed form, most notably at Limerick (2m, soft) in April when beaten 1.75l into third; well-held third last twice, including over C&D; step back up in distance should suit; usually ridden off the pace.
runners.comment: Maiden decent C&D third last month; same spot at Cork 19 days ago; step up in trip suits

runners.name: Whatyouwant
runners.spotlight: Dual handicap hurdle winner, latest at Kilbeggan (3m1f, good) in September off 1lb lower, beating very well-treated Rising Dust; not gone on from that but more positive run at Kilbeggan last month; tame effort over shorter last time and is at his best over further.
runners.comment: Beat well-treated Rising Dust in September; not in same form since, better over further

runners.name: Deise Crystal
runners.spotlight: Struggled on handicap debut at Cork but bounced back since with two placed efforts at Wexford (2m1f, good); didn't find much for pressure when fifth at Wexford over this trip 15 days ago; on a nice mark but questionable whether he relishes this trip.
runners.comment: Good placed efforts over 2m1f at Wexford; found less than looked likely over this trip lto

runners.name: Tedworth
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Tramore (20.5f, yielding) in April off 5lb lower, pulling well clear with second; ran fine at Clonmel off revised mark; unseated back at Tramore when under pressure and beaten 19l, but didn't enjoy a clean run; contender.
runners.comment: Tramore winner in April; shaped better than 19l defeat suggests lto; not out of it

runners.name: The Border Boy
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 25 starts came at Cork (2m1f, good) a year ago; back on that mark but poor on last hurdles run at Punchestown and pulled up over fences here last month; capable but needs to shrug off latest effort.
runners.comment: Back on winning mark from a year ago but needs to shrug off poor effort over fences here

runners.name: Maxicourt
runners.spotlight: Maiden who looked ready to strike when third at Cork (2m1f, good) last month but disappointed as well-backed favourite over same C&D next time; bounced back to some extent when beaten 6.5l at Tramore nine days ago over similar trip (Pure Logic 1.25l ahead); should remain competitive.
runners.comment: Good third at Cork last month, poor fav next time; better effort at Tramore lto; chance

runners.name: Pure Logic
runners.spotlight: Maiden showed promise in bumpers in 2024 but has disappointed a bit in handicap company; good third at Limerick (2m4f, good) in July; matched that with 5l third at Tramore nine days ago; needs more but definitely capable; tongue-tie added with existing cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Promise in bumpers, disappointed since; matched best h'cap form at Tramore lto; chance

runners.name: Ballinvasas Best
runners.spotlight: Off the track two years and progressed from Listowel reappearance to make late headway into fourth at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good) last month; unseated at first 15 days ago; chance if building on that Ballinrobe effort.
runners.comment: Encouraging effort at Ballinrobe after long absence; unseated at first lto; more to come

runners.name: Pirate Island
runners.spotlight: 0-15 over hurdles; won point-to-point in February; no impact in hunter chases in the spring; well beaten in handicap hurdle at Cork 19 days ago; step up in trip will suit but needs more.
runners.comment: Well beaten back over hurdles 19 days ago; step up in trip will suit but needs more

runners.name: Silin Alainn
runners.spotlight: Beaten 20l plus in four maiden hurdles and a handicap; off 672 days and has switched to Gavin Cromwell; stable do well with recruits and it's interesting she's been persevered with; market confidence would have to be taken very seriously.
runners.comment: Nothing worth noting in five starts; switched stable, off 672 days; market check essential

runners.name: Keyser Smokesy
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point form this year nothing to shout about and beaten a fair way in maiden hurdle 36 days ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Moderate point-to-point form this year and well beat in maiden lto; others preferred

runners.name: Coup d'Essay
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly when eighth at Limerick in April (2m, soft); little to shout about otherwise and pulled up behind Andyourbirdcansing 41 days ago; plenty to find.
runners.comment: Moderate h'cap form and pulled up behind Andyourbirdcansing lto; plenty to find

runners.name: Drumadeise
runners.spotlight: Has struggled in three maidens and two handicap runs; others far more convincing.
runners.comment: Has struggled in three maidens and two handicap runs; others far more convincing

runners.name: Lake Okeechobee
runners.spotlight: Step in right direction when a keeping-on fourth at Limerick (2m4f, soft) in May but no impression at Sligo latest behind same rival; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Improved with fourth at Limerick but step backwards again at Sligo; needs to bounce back

runners.name: Laligurash
runners.spotlight: Well beat in maiden hurdles and fared no better on handicap debut 29 days ago; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Well beat in maiden hurdles, fared no better on handicap debut 29 days ago; hard to fancy

runners.name: Ballindenisk
runners.spotlight: First reserve; beaten a long way in maidens; handicap debut not without promise beaten 10.5l at Wexford; step up in trip could suit.
runners.comment: First reserve; h'cap debut not without encouragement beaten 10.5l at Wexford; up in trip
runners.owner: Mrs D W Davenport & Miss F L Garland

races.race_name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Rebel Budz
runners.spotlight: Point winner and progressive in three runs over hurdles, bolting up in a 3m maiden hurdle at Cork in January when last seen; Darragh O'Keeffe sticks with him and a very interesting handicap debutant despite almost eight months off.
runners.comment: Darragh O'Keeffe sticks with him and a very interesting handicap debutant despite absence

runners.name: Hees Dynamite
runners.spotlight: Had a couple of these behind when a close second in a C&D handicap in July; failed to see out his race at Galway since but certainly respected on that previous course form.
runners.comment: Failed to see out his race at Galway but certainly respected on that previous course form

runners.name: Butch Coolidge
runners.spotlight: Got a 9lb hike for winning a Tramore maiden hurdle in May; well held in three novice hurdles since; 4lb wrong on his handicap debut and probably safe to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: 4lb wrong on his handicap debut and probably safe to look elsewhere

runners.name: Londonofficecallin
runners.spotlight: Very solid dual purpose performer; campaigned on the Flat and over fences this year, winning the Cork Derby and second in a Kilbeggan beginners chase; reverts back to hurdles with the stable in cracking form and makes obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Reverts back to hurdles with the stable in cracking form and makes obvious appeal

runners.name: Jupiter Du Gite
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles and fences in Britain on soft/heavy; standout effort for current yard came over here last month when coming home strongly to be beaten a nose in 2m5f handicap hurdle, after being a bit short of room and having to be switched in closing stages; up 3lb for that but should go well.
runners.comment: Unlucky not to win a handicap hurdle here last month; up 3lb for that but should go well

runners.name: Millstream Lady
runners.spotlight: Five hurdle wins to her credit, including this race last year; not seen since running respectably behind Duke Silver at Leopardstown in December; 10lb higher than last year with an eight month absence to overcome.
runners.comment: 10lb higher than when winning this last year with an eight month absence to overcome
runners.owner: Eamon Leahy & Seamus O'Riordan & Edward Hayes

runners.name: Duke Silver
runners.spotlight: Three wins over hurdles including a Pertemps Qualifier at Leopardstown last year; fine fourth in a very competitive handicap hurdle at Punchestown; unseated early on his chase debut at Wexford last month; obvious claims on his return to hurdles.
runners.comment: Unseated early on his chase debut at Wexford; obvious claims on his return to hurdles

runners.name: Frankendael
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over hurdles; not beaten far when stepped up to this trip in a handicap hurdle here last month; worth another try but others make more appeal
runners.comment: Not beaten far when stepped up to this trip in a handicap hurdle here in July; more needed

runners.name: Jazzy Matty
runners.spotlight: First and second in the last two runnings of the Grand Annual at Cheltenham; slightly unlucky in a valuable handicap hurdle at Aintree when last seen; still potentially well handicapped over hurdles and should be a leading player; has won over 2m5f over fences.
runners.comment: Good chaser;still potentially well handicapped over hurdles and should be a leading player

runners.name: Talk In The Park
runners.spotlight: Second in a Galway beginners chase last year and a couple of decent efforts since; some encouragement from his effort at Galway last time but more needed.
runners.comment: Some encouragement from his effort at Galway last time but more needed

runners.name: My Trump Card
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner for Gordon Elliott; two runs for his current stable and probably failed to see out the 3m2f at Ballinrobe last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Probably failed to see out the 3m2f at Ballinrobe last time; others preferred

runners.name: Stormbreaker
runners.spotlight: Listowel maiden hurdle for Willie Mullins; much better effort at Galway last time on his second run for the stable; more needed again but not impossible to see him involved.
runners.comment: Much better effort at Galway last time on his second run for the stable; more needed again

runners.name: Magnor Glory
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner but quite lightly raced in recent times over hurdles and fences; mid-division over C&D in July and his forays over this sort of trip have not convinced; others preferred.
runners.comment: Mid-division over C&D in July and his forays over this sort of trip have not convinced

runners.name: Plontier
runners.spotlight: Sligo maiden hurdle winner for Willie Mullins two years ago; three runs on the Flat for this stable have not revealed a huge amount; best watched.
runners.comment: Three runs on the Flat for this stable have not revealed a huge amount; best watched

races.race_name: Moynihan Scaffolding Ltd. And The Warehouse Cafe Beginners Chase

runners.name: Bowensonfire
runners.spotlight: Very five-time winning useful hurdler, rated 147, goes on any ground; ran to form when 3l second on chase debut at Galway (2m2f, good) 25 days ago; was well held by Daddy Long Legs over hurdles at Limerick in July but was off a break and now has the benefit of a chase run under his belt; big chance.
runners.comment: Five-time winning hurdler, rated 147; solid chase debut lto; big chance if building

runners.name: Eastmore
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent hurdler, latest win came at Limerick (16.5f, good) in handicap off 102, bolted up by 15l; couldn't land a blow off 12lb higher lto; plenty on plate on chase debut; cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Second hurdles win in h'cap last month off 102; lot on plate on chase debut; cheekpieces

runners.name: Daddy Long Legs
runners.spotlight: Five-time winning hurdler, including Grade 3, rated 149 in that sphere; latest success in Ballinrobe (2m2f, good) conditions hurdle in May; solid three runs, including second over hurdles at Limerick since; should go close on chase debut.
runners.comment: Five-time, Grade 3 winning hurdler; good form this season; should go close on chase debut

runners.name: Kilgame
