runners.spotlight: Some good placed efforts in maiden hurdles before getting off the mark at Navan (2m, soft) in March; unseated at second on chase debut 107 days ago; this a tough ask against some smart hurdlers but he's unexposed and can feature.
runners.comment: Soft-ground Navan maiden hurdle winner; unseated on chase debut; likely improver

runners.name: Putapoundinthejar
runners.spotlight: Gained fourth hurdles success with 3.25l victory in Galway Hurdle (2m, good) off 129 23 days ago; still has a bit to find with Daddy Long Legs and Bowensonfire on ratings but claims if taking to new discipline.
runners.comment: Fourth win in Galway Hurdle lto; tough for chase debut but clear claims if taking to it

runners.name: Therellbguddaysyet
runners.spotlight: Consistent 103-rated handicapper over hurdles and fences; pulled up on last chase start in June; outsider.
runners.comment: Consistent 103-rated handicapper; pulled up in June over fences; outsider

races.race_name: Old Market Lane Traders Novice Chase

runners.name: Butch Cassidy
runners.spotlight: Gradually coming to hand over fences and recovered from a bad run at Fairyhouse at Easter when easily landing a decent beginners chase over C&D in May; one of the ones to beat if reproducing that.
runners.comment: Landed a decent beginners chase over C&D in May; one to beat if reproducing that

runners.name: Uncle Pat
runners.spotlight: Several near misses before getting off the mark in spectacular fashion over 3m7f at Punchestown in April; up 12lb for that and was unable to make any impression in the Midlands National at Kilbeggan; far from an easy task here conceding weight over a trip possibly short of his best but clearly a big player.
runners.comment: Has a task conceding weight over a trip maybe short of his best but clearly a big player
runners.owner: Patrick Corbett & Michael Corbett & J J Corbett & W Clancy

runners.name: Yoradreamer
runners.spotlight: Wide margin winner of an ordinary contset at Wexford in March; mixed bag since and not done many favours by his jumping at Galway latest; small field and possibly slower gallop may help but more needed in any case.
runners.comment: Well beaten at Galway; small field and possibly slower gallop may help but more needed

runners.name: Battle Of Benburb
runners.spotlight: Point form amounts to nothing and has shown nothing in two starts for this yard; no chance here.
runners.comment: Point form amounts to nothing and has shown nothing in two starts for this yard; no chance

races.race_name: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)

runners.name: She's A Fine Wine
runners.spotlight: Went up 9lb for a decisive success in quite a valuable 2m handicap chase at Cork in October; won a Downpatrick handicap hurdle after six months off in June before fading rapidly at Galway; first run off her new chase mark here and interesting to see if she is as effective back up in trip; definite chance if she is.
runners.comment: First run off her new chase mark;interesting to see if she is as effective back up in trip

runners.name: Jalila Moriviere
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in a mares' chase at Sligo last October; good runs in defeat in two handicaps at Punchestown; didn't quite get up the hill in the Galway Blazers but this trip and track is likely to suit well; contender.
runners.comment: Didn't get up the hill in the Galway Blazers; this trip and track is likely to suit well

runners.name: Drumgill
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner over hurdles and fences; won a Listed handicap chase over 2m1f at Fairyhouse in November, but it's been mostly downhill since; showed a spark over hurdles at Kilbeggan last time; 3lb wrong here.
runners.comment: Showed a spark over hurdles at Kilbeggan last time; 3lb wrong here

runners.name: Ballybawn Belter
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing run when winning a nice pot at Limerick in December off 3lb lower; modest efforts since, including in the Galway Blazers last time; ground in her favour and running off correct mark are the main positives.
runners.comment: Modest efforts of late; ground in his favour and runs off his mark are the main positives

runners.name: Boston Rover
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick over fences in October but backward steps have followed; not disgraced in the Midlands National but needs to up his game here.
runners.comment: Not disgraced in the Midlands National but needs to up his game here

runners.name: Rexem
runners.spotlight: Rewarded for some consistent efforts when getting up close home for a game success at Kilbeggan two weeks ago; sound jumper and stays well so might not be far away.
runners.comment: Go up close home for a game success at Kilbeggan two weeks ago; should go well

runners.name: Lisleigh Lad
runners.spotlight: Rewarded for some consistent performances when landing a 2m3f handicap chase at Wexford last month; scoped badly at Galway since; 6lb higher than Wexford but still 3lb wrong here.
runners.comment: Scoped badly at Galway last time; 6lb higher than Wexford but still 3lb wrong here

runners.name: Solitary Man
runners.spotlight: Looked to have lost his way in points and hunter chases but came back to his very best when landing the Midlands National at Kilbeggan; never competitive in the Galway Plate but has a stellar record at this venue and should run a big race.
runners.comment: Midlands National winner has a stellar record at this venue and should run a big race
runners.owner: Shanahan/Mrs M V Magnier/Mrs Carthy/Mrs Bartlett

runners.name: Hermino AA
runners.spotlight: Got to the front some way out and held on to win the 3m Connacht National at Roscommon; mid-division off 8lb higher in the Galway Blazers last time; 4lb wrong here and has it to do.
runners.comment: Roscommon winner mid-division in the Galway Blazers last time; 4lb wrong and has it to do

runners.name: West Away
runners.spotlight: Gained a third career win in a 2m3f handicap chase at Wexford two weeks ago; small penalty for that still leaves him 8lb wrong here; difficult task.
runners.comment: Small penalty for Wexford win still leaves him 8lb wrong here; difficult task

runners.name: Senecia
runners.spotlight: High-class performer, and acts well around here having won over hurdles and a Grade 3 chase over this trip in May; found to have burst after unseating in the Galway Plate; back on comfortable territory here and keeps many of these out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Back on Familiarterritory here and keeps many of these out of the handicap; the class act

races.race_name: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners.name: Emergency Man
runners.spotlight: Didn't get the rub of the green when a fine second on debut here last month; sure to improve and be a big player here.
runners.comment: Didn't get much luck when a fine second on debut here last month; sure to improve

runners.name: Teofil
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut at Punchestown and showed a very good attitude to win at Galway; likely to have a bit more use made of him here and will be tough to get past.
runners.comment: Showed a very good attitude to win at Galway; likely to have a bit more use made of him

runners.name: Old Court
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a couple of winners and bred for stamina; pulled up in his sole point-to-point.
runners.comment: Half-brother to a couple of winners and bred for stamina; pulled up in his sole point

runners.name: Ringroan
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; closely related to useful 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase winner Downmexicoway, half-brother to winners Dhowin (2m3f hurdle/3m2f chase), Straight Home (bumper/2m-3m hurdle) and Lady Walk On Bye (bumper); dam unplaced 2m hurdles; nicely bred newcomer but almost certainly best watched.
runners.comment: Nicely bred newcomer but almost certainly best watched

runners.name: Farney Bridge
runners.spotlight: Huge improvement from debut run to win here last month, coming off the pace to beat a horse well beaten since; more needed again here, but respected.
runners.comment: Huge improvement from debut run to win here last month; more needed again

runners.name: Rokanako
runners.spotlight: Workmanlike winner of a Kilbeggan bumper in May and ran respectably under a penalty at Bellewstown; in new hands now and more needed, but should run his race.
runners.comment: Ran respectably under a penalty at Bellewstown; in new hands now and more needed

runners.name: Mystic Bridge
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam unplaced bumpers/hurdles, half-sister to point winner Katishna, out of half-sister to smart 3m hurdler/chaser Pleasure Shared and to the dam of smart chaser Southern Vic; staying pedigree and likely to do better with time and distance.
runners.comment: Staying prdigree and likely to do better with time and distance

runners.name: Loughtown
runners.spotlight: Well beaten but showed some progression on his second start at Wexford; much more needed here.
runners.comment: Well beaten but showed some progression on his second start at Wexford; much more needed

runners.name: Lady Boudica
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a Thurles maiden hurdle for Eddie Power in March; hard to fancy on debut for Eoin McCarthy.
runners.comment: Pulled up in a Thurles maiden hurdle in March; hard to fancy on debut for Eoin McCarthy

races.race_name: Celebrating National Racehorse Week Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Playful Fox
runners.spotlight: Opened his account over hurdles in a Stratford handicap (2m, good to firm) in June off a mark of 99 and ran a solid race when runner-up off 3lb higher at Worcester last month; more is required under a penalty back in novice company against a couple of these but he shouldn't be far away.
runners.comment: Solid in handicaps of late but more will be required under penalty back in novice company.

runners.name: Whermyrosemarygoes
runners.spotlight: Confirmed the promise of her Irish point form when making a winning start to her hurdle career on stable debut at Uttoxeter (2m, good), staying on best under Harry Cobden; may want further in time and this track may be on the sharp side, but she remains a leading player under her penalty.
runners.comment: Won on hurdle/stable debut at Uttoxeter and remains a leading player under a penalty.

runners.name: Lundy View
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability on bumper debut but has not progressed from that and finished tailed off on both starts over hurdles in July; easy to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Hinted at ability on bumper debut but tailed off in two hurdle runs; easy to oppose.

runners.name: Devon Red
runners.spotlight: Showed little in point bumpers and two point starts (2m4f-3m) but offered more when a well-held fourth at Worcester (2m, good) in a first-time hood on hurdle debut; hood removed here and he looks one for the longer term.
runners.comment: Showed more when fourth on hurdle debut at Worcester but looks one for the longer term.

runners.name: Bacardi Blue
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in a bumper, two points and a maiden and a novice hurdle (80-1 and 200-1).
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in a bumper, two points and two runs over hurdles.
runners.owner: D Summersby J May W Dodd

races.race_name: Happy 80th Birthday John Lane Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase

runners.name: My Girl Katie
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent mare who justified support back from an absence when landing a third chase win last month, her second over C&D; up 5lb but Alix Balfe claims 7lb and she'll likely give her running and be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Consistent mare; C&D winner latest; up 5lb but jockey claims 7lb; likely thereabouts.

runners.name: Limerick Leader
runners.spotlight: Just 1-18 over fences but generally consistent and has plenty of placed efforts to his name; below par on his last two starts (2m5f here) and now tackles his longest trip to date, though he stays 3m; remains on a tough-looking mark and others appeal more for the win.
runners.comment: Consistent 1-18 chaser but below par on recent starts and others appeal more for the win.

runners.name: Hardy Buck
runners.spotlight: Won an Exeter hurdle race off a mark of 74 on stable debut in December but has failed to match that level since, including in two starts over fences; last month's reappearance may have been needed when a well-held last of six over hurdles but he has a bit to prove back over fences, despite his lower chase mark.
runners.comment: Exeter hurdle winner in December; below par since and has something to prove back chasing.

runners.name: Sir Carnegie
runners.spotlight: In fine form after blinkers were added in early summer, winning at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) and Hexham (3m, good), before disappointing at Market Rasen last month when reportedly unsuited by the track; retains chase potential and could prove up to this mark if bouncing back.
runners.comment: Two wins in blinkers this summer; below par latest but remains of interest.

runners.name: Honey I'm Good
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner who went close over C&D in June on third run back from a long absence, before tailing off behind My Girl Katie here last month; a player if that is forgiven, with promising Rian Corcoran booked.
runners.comment: Four-time chase winner; close C&D second in June and a player if forgiving latest run.

runners.name: Great d'Ange
runners.spotlight: Four-time chase winner who has returned to form on his last two starts, both over C&D, latest when just under 2l behind My Girl Katie; 2lb better off with that rival despite a 3lb rise and should be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: Four-time chase winner; in good form over C&D and should be thereabouts again.

races.race_name: Philip Wilson Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: Ice Jet
runners.spotlight: Showed the benefit of wind surgery when winning three hurdle races on the bounce in May and very nearly defied a 4lb lower mark than this at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) in July on chase debut; latest race was voided well before the finish; strong claims.
runners.comment: Won three hurdle races in May; close chase debut second off 4lb lower; strong claims.

runners.name: Gore Point
runners.spotlight: Hat-trick (2m-extended 2m3f) before the break included two C&D wins in July, latest when scoring convincingly off an 8lb lower mark and the runner-up has run well since; this mark demands more but he's thriving and a bold bid can be expected for the four-timer.
runners.comment: Hat-trick before break; latest C&D win was convincing; leading player despite 8lb rise.

runners.name: Cobbler's Boy
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in May and respectable second over hurdles the following month, but he was well beaten back over fences at Hexham (raced freely) last month and subsequently left Dan Skelton's stable for £5,000; retains chase potential but others are more persuasive.
runners.comment: C&D winner in May; runner-up next time but well beaten on final run for Dan Skelton

runners.name: Hooper
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler in his prime but he's been well below that level in three starts for this stable since returning from a long absence, latest when a 34l fourth back over fences at Stratford (extended 2m3f) last month; has enough to prove at present.
runners.comment: Useful hurdler in his prime but well below that level since returning from an absence.

races.race_name: Torbay Weekly Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Mi Sueno
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with a C&D win on last month's debut for Nick Scholfield, having a few of these in behind and scoring a shade cosily; remains well treated despite a 5lb rise and is the one to beat if backing up that effort.
runners.comment: C&D winner last month; remains well treated despite 5lb rise and is the one to beat.

runners.name: Ugo Bingo
runners.spotlight: Below his best in three runs since returning from a break but he is on a competitive mark and may benefit from recent wind surgery.
runners.comment: Below best since a break but well treated and recent wind surgery could help.

runners.name: Saucats
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 25th attempt when scoring comfortably over C&D in July and both subsequent efforts in defeat have been solid, including when a 5l third to Mi Sueno here last time; likely to be thereabouts again.
runners.comment: C&D winner in July and two solid runs since; likely to be thereabouts again.

runners.name: Man Oh Man
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden and not easy to predict but went close over C&D in June before finishing 54l behind Mi Sueno back here next time; needs the first-time blinkers to prove a positive addition.
runners.comment: 16-race maiden; went close over C&D in June but poor since; blinkers may help.

runners.name: Hawa Jumeirah
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner who has produced two encouraging placed efforts over C&D of late; has a bit to find with some of these but should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner; placed over C&D last twice and likely to be in the mix again.

runners.name: Son Of Hypnos
runners.spotlight: Galway festival winner in 2024 but hasn't matched that level since and has been well beaten on four of his five starts for this yard this year, latest when a 16l fourth to Mi Sueno over C&D last month; remains with plenty to find with that rival despite better terms.
runners.comment: Well held by Mi Sueno over C&D latest and has plenty to find despite better terms.

runners.name: Lakefield Flyer
runners.spotlight: Three-time chase winner, latest at Stratford (extended 2m3f) in June, but 0-10 over hurdles; has left Shark Hanlon since a disappointing chase run at Uttoxeter last month but not out of this if reproducing his encouraging third off this mark at Market Rasen on penultimate start.
runners.comment: Three-time chase winner; 0-10 over hurdles but not ruled out of this mark on stable debut

runners.name: Uncle Remus
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner in July 2025 but his efforts over hurdles have been underwhelming, including in three handicaps; needs to recapture his earlier promise for Robert Stephens but a change of scenery may help as he makes his debut for Henrietta Knight with Sean Bowen booked.
runners.comment: Bumper winner; disappointing over hurdles but change of yard may help; Sean Bowen booked.

runners.name: Electric Eddy
runners.spotlight: Reverts to hurdles after an unsuccessful spell over fences; sole win came in this sphere nearly two years ago, albeit having been lightly campaigned since; now 3lb below that winning mark and the return to hurdles may see him in a better light.
runners.comment: Back over hurdles off 3lb below his sole winning mark and could be seen in a better light.

runners.name: Hillsin
runners.spotlight: Won at Exeter in October but has been poor since, including when pulled up and tailed off on two starts this summer; has become well treated and is capable if in the mood, but he's not without risk.
runners.comment: Exeter winner in October and well treated now, but poor lately and comes with risks.

races.race_name: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: American Sniper
runners.spotlight: Made all in a C&D 0-115 in May (good) off 6lb lower; has it to prove that this isn't as good as he is nowadays, a subsequent Uttoxeter failure having come in a Class 2 which looks no stronger than today's.
runners.comment: Made all in a C&D 0-115 in May; below par in similar standard of Class 2 to today's since.

runners.name: Handlethekettle
runners.spotlight: 4-4 over hurdles in class 2 or lower for Jamie Snowden, always making all; not seen since landing a 2m4f Worcester Class 2 (effectively a 0-135) in July 2025, but pace rivalry here concerns at least as much.
runners.comment: Made every yard for all four hurdles wins in 2024 and 2025; there's pace competition here.

runners.name: Supreme Yeats
runners.spotlight: 2-2 in stayers' handicaps here; June's Hexham third to Divilabother (hat-trick scorer subsequently) looks better form now than then, and he's resumed winning ways over a 2m4f trip at the lowest end of his range since; disinterest in contesting the early pace might prove an asset today; big player.
runners.comment: Wins already this season from 2m4f-3m3f (good); unlikely to contest the lead; big player.
runners.owner: The Old Stag Racing Sy Partnership

runners.name: Letterston Lily
runners.spotlight: Defied 17-month absence at Perth in April (2m4f, good) before finding things happening too quickly in the Summer Hurdle latest; new trip asks a question, but notable her full sister has won over further still.
runners.comment: Things happened too quickly in the Summer Hurdle latest; new trip could be within range.

runners.name: Morning Mayhem
runners.spotlight: Interesting he was still staying on into fourth (about 23l ahead of Letterston Lily) at the end of a generously run Summer Hurdle last time, though remains untried beyond a sharp 2m4f; 7lb higher mark than for June's easy 2m1f win here leaves him with almost nothing in hand.
runners.comment: Still staying on at the end of the Summer Hurdle; almost nothing in hand of his mark.

runners.name: Kitty Foyle
runners.spotlight: 2m1f mares' novice winner on sole previous course visit in 2024, but this last spring's far superior form efforts win or lose were recorded over stayers' trips; didn't offer anything on last month's Flat return.
runners.comment: Improved hurdling form in the spring came over stayers' trips; last home on Flat latest.

runners.name: Zillow
runners.spotlight: The wheels came off following last November's Listed Fairyhouse win for Willie Mullins (yielding to soft), and nothing about either start for latest handler has suggested an imminent revival; yet to convince beyond 2m.
runners.comment: Listed winner for Willie Mullins last November but really struggling since; better at 2m.

runners.name: Soul Icon
runners.spotlight: Way better chaser than a 1-18 return suggests (Grade 2 winner), and not too far off his best despite finishing just sixth in the Summer Plate latest; terrific strike-rate as a hurdler (ran up a five-timer in 2022), but continued effectiveness over these obstacles untested since autumn 2023.
runners.comment: Sixth in Summer Plate latest; no hurdles starts since autumn 2023 (8-15 over them).

races.race_name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Max Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; C&D record reads 111244, albeit Arctic Voyage beat her 11l here in July and she finished 27l fourth in this race last year; back on her last winning mark, but vulnerable to less exposed types.
runners.comment: 111244 over C&D; well held in this last year; 11l to find with Arctic Voyage from July.
runners.owner: Mrs S D Pearson & Ollie Pears

runners.name: Lunar Orbit
runners.spotlight: Nearly 6l too good for Mojito Des Mottes in taking a Market Rasen juvenile last December (2m1f, good to soft), but sold out of Warren Greatrex's yard after a moderate handicap debut; this wouldn't be any easier, but no surprise were the wind surgery, tongue tie and/or move to his top new connections to prove transformative.
runners.comment: Moderate handicap debut last winter; wind surgery since; tongue tie added on stable bow.

runners.name: Mojito Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Appeared unlucky to go down by under a length at Ascot in March (traffic issues), but didn't enjoy himself in the Summer Hurdle on sole start since; still early days in handicaps, and no ground issues.
runners.comment: Still early days in handicaps, so could yet put last time's Summer Hurdle run behind him.

runners.name: Arctic Voyage
runners.spotlight: Ground perhaps softer than advertised when beaten 26l here in June, but otherwise 3-4 when completing for current handler, readily accounting for Max Of Stars and Charlus over C&D latest (good); another personal best required off a mark 4lb higher than any RPR ever run to.
runners.comment: Beat two of these over C&D latest (good); another career best required off revised mark.

runners.name: Sayva
runners.spotlight: Didn't kick on over fences during a light 2025-26 campaign; interesting to see whether the all-the-way tactics of his earlier Newcastle and Hereford non-handicap hurdle wins are reprised with Max Of Stars in opposition.
runners.comment: Didn't kick on over fences; will face pace rivalry if reprising hurdles-winning tactics.

runners.name: Charlus
runners.spotlight: Mostly stiff tasks since arrival in Britain but disappointing even so, posing zero threat in the Summer Hurdle latest; hard to entertain despite this easier grade, and winless on sound turf surfaces also.
runners.comment: Probable sound surface and balance of form since arrival in Britain render him opposable.

races.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.name: Don't Stop Movin
runners.spotlight: May's 3l second on debut here (7f, good) is the strongest piece of turf form on offer; weakening effort at Ayr since was owed to a refusal to settle rather than stamina issues, and this drop to 6f can't rate an obvious plus for one quite so stoutly bred (1m3f-2m winners in pedigree).
runners.comment: Chance on the form of debut second here in May (good), albeit over a 7f likelier to suit.

runners.name: Green Bay Dream
runners.spotlight: No match for the useful-looking Mill Reef entry Pure Mint on last month's Ripon debut (good to firm), but had a next-time winner behind; consolidated rather than built upon that effort over the same C&D last weekend, but wouldn't need to find much improvement to go close here.
runners.comment: Second (behind a good winner) and third in two 6f Ripon novice events; among likeliest.

runners.name: Callisterra
runners.spotlight: June's C&D restricted novice second (good; beaten almost 5l) represented a fair step up on her debut effort, and the fourth won next time out; just a little more improvement ought to have her thereabouts.
runners.comment: Near-5l C&D novice second (good) when last seen; not much improvement needed to go close.

runners.name: On Golden Pond
runners.spotlight: Nephew of Albany Stakes winner Cuis Ghaire and has plenty to offer over 6f as a 2yo himself, judged on last month's Newcastle debut fourth when beaten under 1l; RPR of 72 just sets the standard in this line-up, and no reason why he'd struggle to translate that ability to turf.
runners.comment: Beaten under 1l on July's Newcastle debut (6f); no reason why he'd not function on turf.

runners.name: Commander Keith
runners.spotlight: Calyx half-brother to winners at 5f-7f (one useful) out of a half-sister to the prolific pair Two Tempting (runs at Chester today) and Sweet Reward; just the Frost yard's second 2yo of 2026 (the other is 0-4).
runners.comment: Nephew of two prolific types; yard has sent out only one other 2yo so far in 2026 (0-4).

runners.name: Seadreamin
runners.spotlight: By Aclaim but sprint winners wherever you look among his siblings and the damside pedigree, notably Eastern Romance (French 2yo Listed scorer); most appealing of the newcomers and well worth a market check.
runners.comment: Sprint winners all over the damside pedigree, and the most appealing of the newcomers.

runners.name: Orfilia
runners.spotlight: 52,000euros yearling whose siblings have variously struck in everything from British sprints (some useful form) to Czech hurdles; yard's 2yos not wildly prolific yet this term, but she starts at a realistic level.
runners.comment: Sibling to winners across numerous distances and disciplines; starts at a realistic level.

runners.name: Piper Cee
runners.spotlight: 9-1 fourth favourite, 13l last of seven on this month's Nottingham debut (6f, good to firm), short of room at one stage but by no means unlucky; plenty more required.
runners.comment: 13l last of seven on recent Nottingham debut (6f, good to firm); plenty more required.

runners.name: Ubetawatchout
runners.spotlight: Fared only marginally better for gelding at Newcastle latest, and yet to see out 6f at all convincingly; may need more time.
runners.comment: Has not seen out 6f at all convincingly on either start, and may need more time.

runners.name: Hey Dougie
runners.spotlight: Unable to break out of rear on either start so far, beating nothing home over 7f latest; one for later on.
runners.comment: Unable to break out of rear on either start so far, beating nothing home over 7f latest.

runners.name: Dontlookanyfurther
runners.spotlight: Still had running left when badly hampered 2f out on last month's Thirsk debut (6f, good to firm); good chance he'll prove better than that here; yard's 2yos have got off the mark for 2026 in the interim.
runners.comment: Badly hampered on Thirsk debut (6f) when still had running left; likely capable of better.

runners.name: Whichonesthat
runners.spotlight: 125-1, refused to settle in rear on last month's Newcastle debut (6f), finishing well held just behind Ubetawatchout; way more needed.
runners.comment: Refused to settle in rear on last month's Newcastle debut (6f); big improvement needed.

races.race_name: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes

runners.name: Penny Arcade
runners.spotlight: Some promise in three runs for Karl Burke but a well-beaten last in both runs for her new stable; steps up in trip on a recovery mission.
runners.comment: Well-beaten last in both runs for new yard; stamina to prove; risky

runners.name: Bigalo
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in all three nursery starts (7f, good or good to firm), the latest at Musselburgh 15 days ago; solid claims at the weights now dropping into a seller.
runners.comment: Runner-up all three nursery starts; solid claims at the weights dropped into a seller

runners.name: Amantha
runners.spotlight: Improved to win a 7f seller at Musselburgh (good ground) in June; the odd good nursery run has followed and she's respected despite having to shoulder a penalty.
runners.comment: Won a Musselburgh seller in June; fair nursery form since; respected despite her penalty

runners.name: Hidden Army
runners.spotlight: 7,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Sapphire Steps (RPR 83); dam 7f 2yo/1m winner (89); enough paper appeal to warrant a look in the betting.
runners.comment: 7,000euros half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Sapphire Steps; worth a market check on debut

runners.name: Maleny
runners.spotlight: 18,000euros yearling; third foal; half-sister to 1m1f turf/1m3f AW winner It's Only Fun (RPR 76); unraced dam closely related to 6f Listed winner and Irish 1,000 Guineas runner-up Dimenticata; starts out at a low level; check the betting.
runners.comment: 18,000euros half-sister to 1m1mf-1m3f winner It's Only Fun; starting out at a low level

runners.name: Here's To It
runners.spotlight: 5,500gns yearling; seventh foal; half-sister to winners Skilled Warrior (7.3f turf/1m AW; RPR 96), Rumbo Norte (French 1m2f-1m4f; 80), Maguro (French 9.5f AW; 77) and Statham (Swiss 1m1f); dam French 1m 2yo winner (including Listed; 95); won't have to be anything out of the ordinary to feature and the betting will guide; stable also runs Hope Of Acklam.
runners.comment: 5,500gns half-sister to four winners out of a French Listed winner; betting instructive

runners.name: Breaking The Habit
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two 7f novice runs this month; connections wasted little time dropping him into a seller and it will be interesting to see if there is any money about for him.
runners.comment: Modest form in two 7f novice runs this month; quickly dropped in class; check betting

runners.name: Expensive Luxury
runners.spotlight: Little short-term promise in novice events at Wolverhampton (6f) or Haydock (7f, good) this summer; from a powerful yard but not easily recommended.
runners.comment: Little short-term promise in two novice events this summer; not easily recommended

runners.name: Senorita Luna
runners.spotlight: Lowly RPRs in a couple of AW runs (7f/1m) this summer; drops in class and switches to turf but still has too much to prove for comfort.
runners.comment: Lowly RPRs in two AW runs this summer; down in class for turf debut
runners.owner: Mohamed Rashid Hamdan Al Saadi & Partner

runners.name: Hope Of Acklam
runners.spotlight: 33-1 when always behind on his debut at Thirsk (6f, good) last week; quickly dropped in class; stable also runs Here's To It.
runners.comment: Well-beaten 33-1 shot on last week's debut at Thirsk (6f); quickly dropped in grade

runners.name: Right Up My Ali
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in two maidens in June; drops in class with a point to prove.
runners.comment: Big prices and well beaten in two maidens in June; drops in class with a point to prove

races.race_name: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)

runners.name: Regalian
runners.spotlight: Form figures of 6888 since leaving William Haggas; has dropped 10lb for his troubles but best watched for now.
runners.comment: Form figures of 6888 since leaving William Haggas; dropped 10lb for his troubles

runners.name: Mr King
runners.spotlight: Third run for this yard when a head winner at Thirsk (7f, good) and was bang there in a big field at York (good to firm) despite a troubled passage; stays 1m and plenty to like.
runners.comment: Won at Thirsk before bang there in a big field at York (hit traffic)

runners.name: Boy Named Sioux
runners.spotlight: Sole win was on the AW during the winter (7f); pretty ordinary since then, with and without a hood.
runners.comment: Sole win was on the AW during the winter (7f); pretty ordinary since then
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Queen Tamara
runners.spotlight: Last season ended well, following her maiden win with a near miss off 1lb lower at Newmarket (7f); yet to recapture that form this campaign (7f/1m), though she was sent to Ascot and Goodwood; better expected.
runners.comment: Struggled this term at Ascot and Goodwood; contender on last autumn's good efforts

runners.name: Substance
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap over a similar trip for Joseph O'Brien whom he left for 28,000gns; started slowly and never involved on last week's stable debut (7f, good; 33-1).
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; started slowly and never involved on last week's stable debut (7f, good; 33-1)

runners.name: Kaleido
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-11, the win in a 7f maiden for the Gosdens; two near misses in handicaps at about 1m this summer and reportedly ran flat last time; hard to dismiss.
runners.comment: Near misses in handicaps at about 1m this summer and reportedly ran flat last time

runners.name: Mount King
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner at Pontefract where he was competitive last month; for whatever reason he never gave his running last week at Thirsk.
runners.comment: Was in form but for whatever reason he never gave his running last week at Thirsk

runners.name: Poet's Dawn
runners.spotlight: Admirable veteran who recently completed a hat-trick over 1m2f before disappointing last week at Doncaster; has to bounce back from that, but he should be fine returned to 1m.
runners.comment: Recently completed a hat-trick over 1m2f before disappointing last week at Doncaster

runners.name: Rajapour
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last month off 8lb lower and the following week suffered a fall at York; good to see him bounce back from that with a respectable show at Hamilton; this mark might be on the high side.
runners.comment: C&D winner last month; only fifth at Hamilton since and this mark might be on high side

runners.name: Camino Del Ray
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner, latterly in March when in first-time cheekpieces, after which he finished last of the four at Wolverhampton (scoped dirty); could be given another chance but he's been off since April.
runners.comment: Both wins on the AW; excuses last time; has been off since April

races.race_name: Bakers Tailoring Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Mudita
runners.spotlight: Landed a Ripon maiden (1m2f, good) in April; ran well enough in three handicaps after before finding Ascot a tad too competitive in July; back in calmer waters here and should not be far away.
runners.comment: Ran well enough in three handicaps before finding Ascot too competitive; this is easier

runners.name: Woodleigh
runners.spotlight: Recorded his second win over C&D (good to firm) in May and followed up at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) the following month; has been in a battle with the handicapper since and probably needs to come down a few pounds.
runners.comment: Recorded his second win over C&D in May and followed up at Doncaster the following month.

runners.name: Eve's Boy
runners.spotlight: Yet to win a handicap since landing a 7f Ayr novice in September 2024; steps up in trip off a career-low mark but others preferred.
runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap after landing a 7f Ayr novice in September 2024; up in trip.

runners.name: Fille Imbassee
runners.spotlight: Made all to land a three-runner handicap at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) in June; collared inside the final furlong when trying to adopt the same tactics in another small field over the same C&D last month and it remains to be seen if she can dictate in this bigger field.
runners.comment: Front-runner who made all at Leicester in June and was collared close home last time.

runners.name: Poppeye
runners.spotlight: Showed improvement when runner-up at this track (1m, good) in June on his handicap debut; there should be more to come from him stepping back up in trip and he should have a big shout.
runners.comment: Improved form when 2nd here in June on handicap debut  (1m); now back at 1m2f

runners.name: Sogniamo
runners.spotlight: Left last year's debut behind when springing an 80-1 surprise at Hamilton (1m1f, good to firm) on her comeback in May; since disappointing in three handicaps and, while it's still early days, it's hard to be confident about her today.
runners.comment: Scored at 80-1 in May; beaten in three handicaps since; hard to be confident this time

runners.name: Mighty Quiet
runners.spotlight: Looked a non-stayer over 1m4f in June and was never in contention after a slow start at Salisbury (1m2f) in June; now back on her last winning mark and not out of this.
runners.comment: Looked a non-stayer over 1m4f in June and never in contention after slow start last time.

runners.name: Bay Dream Believer
runners.spotlight: Has won twice this year, at 1m2f and about 1m, but is 2lb above her highest winning mark so probably needs a career best to be successful here.
runners.comment: Has won twice this year, including at 1m2f, but now 2lb above her highest winning mark

runners.name: Kartini
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden; has finished last on both starts over 1m for current stable this year and cannot be considered at present.
runners.comment: Has finished last on both starts over 1m for current stable this year.

races.race_name: Bakers Tailoring Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Sweet Kiss
runners.spotlight: Scored three times at 1m2f in 2025; comes here in decent nick, finishing sixth of 11 in 1m2f handicap at Ayr 12 days ago; not out of things with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: In decent nick, sixth at Ayr 12 days ago; not out of things with cheekpieces added

runners.name: Always Blue
runners.spotlight: Caught the eye on her handicap debut with third of nine at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) last month, keeping on late having been set plenty to do; this Masar filly has more to offer and rates an interesting prospect off a 2lb lower mark.
runners.comment: Caught the eye on handicap debut with third at Wolverhampton; interesting off 2lb lower

runners.name: Ceinture d'Orion
runners.spotlight: Fair form shown when in the frame on her last three runs, posting a good third of 11 in 1m2f handicap at Ayr 12 days ago; still quite lightly raced so very much one to consider off the same mark.
runners.comment: Fair form shown when in the frame on her last three runs; considered off the same mark

runners.name: Yafaarr
runners.spotlight: Scored over 1m here in June and has continued in good form, although not seen to best effect with fourth of six in 1m2f handicap at Nottingham last time; in the picture.
runners.comment: Scored over 1m here in June and has continued in good form; in the picture

runners.name: Boubyan
runners.spotlight: Scored at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) in March but not proving the easiest to catch right since, finishing just a fair third of six at Brighton (1m) 16 days ago; others are preferred.
runners.comment: Scored at Newcastle (1m2f) in March but not proving the easiest to catch right since

runners.name: Whiskey Pete
runners.spotlight: Sole success came back in 2023 but he got back on track with second of six in 1m2f handicap at Doncaster three weeks ago; needs to reproduce it now.
runners.comment: Back on track with second at Doncaster three weeks ago; needs to reproduce it now

runners.name: Chesneys Charm
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f winner in 2025 for Grant Tuer; has failed to fire this season though, and underwent breathing surgery before coming in seventh in 1m handicap here for new yard two weeks ago; lots more is needed.
runners.comment: A fair 7f winner in 2025 for Grant Tuer; has failed to fire this season though
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

runners.name: Cosmos Raj
runners.spotlight: A three-time 1m winner in 2025 but yet to hit top form this season, finishing just fourth of six in 1m Pontefract handicap 17 days ago; on a falling mark but more is required.
runners.comment: A three-time 1m winner in 2025 but yet to hit top form this season; more is required

races.race_name: Market Cross Jewellers Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Taygar
runners.spotlight: C&D scorer; in very good form without winning until just sixth of eight in 6f Thirsk handicap last month; she's the sort to bounce back though.
runners.comment: In good form until sixth at Thirsk last month; she's the sort to bounce back though

runners.name: Spirit Of Applause
runners.spotlight: Reliable sort who comes here on the back of a good second of nine in 5f Pontefract handicap 17 days ago; can make his presence felt off the same mark.
runners.comment: Good second at Pontefract 17 days ago; can make his presence felt off the same mark

runners.name: Mr Cool
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing sequence at Ayr (6f) in July and backed it up with a solid third of 13 in another 6f handicap there two weeks ago; enters calculations again.
runners.comment: Solid third of 13 in Ayr handicap (6f) two weeks ago; enters calculations again

runners.name: Missmimi
runners.spotlight: Bagged a third success of 2025 over C&D in November; off for nine months, having undergone breathing surgery, before returning with a good third of nine at Pontefract (5f) 17 days ago; one to consider now.
runners.comment: Off nine months before a good third at Pontefract 17 days ago; one to consider

runners.name: Liverpool Star
runners.spotlight: Gained a first success at Ripon (6f) in April; mainly in good form since, though only ninth of 12 in 5.5f York handicap last month; no surprise to see him get back on track here.
runners.comment: In good form until ninth at York last month; no surprise to see him get back on track here

runners.name: Ingleby Archie
runners.spotlight: Gained a first victory of 2026 at Nottingham (6f) in June and in good form since, leading for long way when fifth of 21 in 6f York handicap 29 days ago; this course winner can go very well eased 1lb here.
runners.comment: Led long way when good fifth of 21 at York 29 days ago; can go very well eased 1lb here

runners.name: Showtime Mahomes
runners.spotlight: In winning form on the AW over the winter; had been off for five months when not disgraced with fifth of ten in 6f Southwell AW handicap 16 days ago; can build on it here.
runners.comment: Back from five months off when not disgraced with 5th at Southwell latest; can build on it

runners.name: Hover On The Wind
runners.spotlight: Landed a pair of 5f Pontefract handicaps this summer but he's been well below par there and at Thirsk (5f) since; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Dual winner at Pontefract in June/July but well below par there and at Thirsk (5f) since

runners.name: Sugar Baby
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways at Doncaster (6f) in June; well held in 6f handicaps at York and Pontefract since, however, so this C&D scorer needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Well held at York and Pontefract last two runs; more is needed from this C&D scorer
runners.owner: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing

runners.name: Raatea
runners.spotlight: In good form on the AW at Newcastle early in 2026; had been off for four months and was very slowly away when 13th of 21 in 6f York handicap last month; can take a step forward here.
runners.comment: Off four months before 13th in 6f York handicap last month; can take a step forward here

runners.name: The Caltonian
runners.spotlight: All his seven victories have come on the AW but he wasn't discredited with fourth of ten in 6f Newmarket handicap 15 days ago; not out of things eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Not discredited with fourth in Newmarket handicap 15 days ago; not out of things eased 1lb
runners.owner: John Murphy & Miss L A Perratt

races.race_name: Market Cross Jewellers Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Come On Over
runners.spotlight: Gained a first success at Doncaster (6f) in July and recorded a solid fourth of eight in another 6f handicap there three weeks ago; not out of things eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Solid fourth over 6f at Doncaster three weeks ago; not out of things eased 1lb
runners.owner: Come On Over Syndicate & A H Yates Ltd

runners.name: Farandaway
runners.spotlight: A two-time 6f/7f scorer this season; posted another solid effort with sixth of 11 in 7f Haydock handicap 15 days ago; this consistent sort must enter calculations.
runners.comment: Solid sixth in Haydock handicap 15 days ago; this consistent sort must enter calculations

runners.name: Marajito
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Ripon (5f) in May and comes here on the back of a good second of five there (5f) 19 days ago; this course scorer needs considering.
runners.comment: Good second of five at Ripon (5f) 19 days ago; this course scorer needs considering

runners.name: Magistery
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at Carlisle (6f) last September but she has failed to beat a rival in her last three starts, last time in a 7f Catterick handicap in July; needs a subsequent breathing operation to yield major progress.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival in last three starts; needs a wind op to yield major progress

runners.name: Rotokura Belle
runners.spotlight: Doubled her winning tally for 2026 at York (5f) in June but turned in a below-par seventh of 12 at Thirsk (5f) three weeks ago; needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: Below-par seventh of 12 at Thirsk (5f) three weeks ago; needs to get back on track

runners.name: Speeding Bullet
runners.spotlight: A fair 6f scorer in 2025; yet to hit top form in four runs this season, though better signs with fifth of nine in 5f Beverley handicap 25 days ago; not ruled out off a falling mark.
runners.comment: Better signs with fifth at Beverley 25 days ago; not ruled out off a falling mark
runners.owner: Slaters Arms Racing And Ged Shields

runners.name: Bonnie's Boy
runners.spotlight: A fair 5f winner in 2025; lightly raced this season and he wasn't discredited when fourth of 21 in 6f York handicap 29 days ago; in the picture eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Not discredited when fourth of 21 in 6f York handicap 29 days ago; in the picture

runners.name: Men Of Honour
runners.spotlight: Fair ex-Irish maiden; yet to show his best form for new yard this term, beating only one in 7f Thirsk handicap in July; hopes are pinned on a wind operation sparking a revival.
runners.comment: Beat just one at Thirsk in July; hopes are pinned on a wind operation sparking a revival
runners.owner: Buist, Shields, Thompson And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Irish Nectar
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2024 but he comes here in good nick, not seen to ideal effect when ninth of 12 in 6f Southwell AW handicap last month when racing wide; of some interest off a 3lb lower mark with yard going very well.
runners.comment: Not seen to best effect with Southwell ninth latest; of some interest for in-form yard

races.race_name: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap

runners.name: Ellie's de Vega
runners.spotlight: 0-13 but consistent and was a rallying second on yard debut over 5f here (good to firm) two weeks ago; considered back at 6f with Tom Kiely-Marshall taking off 5lb.
runners.comment: Rallying second here over 5f for new yard and Tom Kiely-Marshall takes off 5lb

runners.name: Indy's Angel
runners.spotlight: Only 1-24 and again came up short at Yarmouth (6f) where she was given every chance; looks hard to win with.
runners.comment: Only 1-24 and again came up short at Yarmouth (6f) where she was given every chance

runners.name: South Shore Island
runners.spotlight: Went close over C&D two runs ago but wasn't so good at Hamilton 11 days ago and is now 0-28; a first-time tongue-tie is added.
runners.comment: Went close over C&D two runs ago but wasn't so good at Hamilton and now 0-28

runners.name: Battenburg Belle
runners.spotlight: 6f winner in June off this mark and she's consistent in the main; no reason why she shouldn't be involved.
runners.comment: 6f winner in June off this mark and she's consistent in the main

runners.name: Sparkling Wine
runners.spotlight: Runner-up a couple of times but remains a maiden and she ran poorly last time; best form has been at 5f.
runners.comment: Runner-up a couple of times but remains a maiden and ran poorly last time

runners.name: Stormy Pearl
runners.spotlight: C&D winner but likes the stiffer finish of Hamilton and got a tad outpaced before running on over C&D last month; however, she's closely matched with the winner Night Emperor and has to enter the reckoning.
runners.comment: Closely matched with recent C&D winner Night Emperor and has to enter the reckoning

runners.name: Drish Samphire
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in first nine races but put that right when overcoming a slow start to win a 6f classified race at Thirsk recently; back up 4lb but Cian Horgan can claim his 5lb this time.
runners.comment: Overcame a slow start to win a 6f classified race at Thirsk; might be improving

runners.name: Night Emperor
runners.spotlight: Had hinted at winning potential before prevailing in a tight finish over C&D (good to firm) last month; ran on well late on and could be good value for the neck winning margin; 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Had hinted at winning potential before prevailing in a tight finish over C&D last month

runners.name: Lope Y Linda
runners.spotlight: Last win was in a 7f classified event and is probably weighted to her best but she gives her running more often than not irrespective of trip.
runners.comment: Dual winner; gives her running more often than not irrespective of trip

runners.name: Lady Grey
runners.spotlight: No clear positives to take from her first three races and only of interest if there's money around for her.
runners.comment: Few positives to take from her first three races; only of interest if money for her

runners.name: Ziva's Star
runners.spotlight: Runs well now and again but arrives here with a record of 0-24 and from out of the weights; blinkers replace cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Runs well now and again but arrives here 0-24 and from out of the weights

runners.name: Mrs Trump
runners.spotlight: Won a division of this two years ago but she has to step up on her recent efforts, last time finishing behind Drish Samphire.
runners.comment: Won a division of this two years ago but has to step up on her recent efforts
runners.owner: R Chapman, G J Daly & R J Parks

runners.name: Rinky Tinky Tinky
runners.spotlight: Only 1-18 and opposable on what she's achieved in four races after a break; just out of the weights.
runners.comment: Only 1-18 and opposable on what she's achieved in four races since a break

runners.name: Fair Isle Sioux
runners.spotlight: 6yo who has raced only four times; 66-1 for handicap debut at Thirsk (7f) and beat just one home.
runners.comment: 66-1 for handicap debut at Thirsk (7f) and beat just one home

runners.name: Macedonian
runners.spotlight: Off a much reduced mark and with a new visor fitted he ran his best race for a while to be second of 13 at Ayr (6f, good to soft) recently; clear claims if he can back that up.
runners.comment: In a new visor when second at Ayr (6f) and has clear claims if he can back that up

runners.name: Hurstwood
runners.spotlight: Won divisions of this in 2022 and 2024 but he's looking regressive; only seventh in a classified race at Thirsk last time which was won by Drish Samphire; 1lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Won divisions of this in 2022 and 2024; looks regressive now and 7th in classified latest
runners.owner: Hard Held Partnership And Angus Racing

runners.name: Lindoro
runners.spotlight: Some promise initially but well held in 5f/6f handicaps, latterly when tongue tied in cheekpieces, and more new headgear tried here.
runners.comment: Some promise initially but well held in 5f/6f handicaps and a headgear switch tried today

races.race_name: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Mwafaq
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo who landed his third win of the year, at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) last month in gritty fashion; no disgrace in going down by a neck at Hamilton (8.5f, good) three weeks ago and remains in top form; worth following on this step up in trip.
runners.comment: Progressive 4yo who landed his third win of the year, at Doncaster last month.
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Orchard
runners.spotlight: Sole success came at Kempton last May; made the frame on all three starts this summer and should give another good account.
runners.comment: Made the frame on all three starts this summer and should give another good account.

runners.name: Cloth Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Has reportedly been plagued by injuries and hasn't been able to build on his sole win at Newcastle AW last October; still 4lb above his winning mark but does seem more effective on AW.
runners.comment: Hasn't been able to build on his sole win at Newcastle AW last October.

runners.name: Wanderlust
runners.spotlight: Sole success came when trained in France last September; has run to a consistent level in four runs for his current trainer this term without suggesting a win is imminent but dons first-time cheekpieces which may have a positive impact.
runners.comment: Has run to a consistent level in four outings for his current trainer this term.

runners.name: Pomme Pomme
runners.spotlight: Completed a five-timer at Haydock last summer; still 5lb above her last winning mark and continues to look in the handicapper's grip.
runners.comment: Completed a five-timer at Haydock last summer; still 5lb above her last winning mark.

runners.name: Moonrunner
runners.spotlight: Three promising efforts before disappointing when beaten 17l on handicap debut at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft; 11-4) in June; still early days and may warrant another chance back on AW and down in trip.
runners.comment: Disappointing when beaten 17l on handicap debut at Yarmouth in June.

runners.name: Kokanee
runners.spotlight: Two-time winner, the latest on the turf track here (1m2f, soft) in June; needs to show he is as effective on AW.
runners.comment: Won on the turf track here in June; needs to show he is as effective on AW.

runners.name: Skibo
runners.spotlight: Placed four times last year but beaten around 20l on return at this track (1m4f) in April; subsequently left Ralph Beckett for 10,000gns and has had wind surgery; best watched on stable debut.
runners.comment: Placed four times last year but beaten around 20l on return at this track in April.

runners.name: Epictetus
runners.spotlight: Recorded his first win since landing a Group 3 in August 2023 at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) 16 days ago in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) off 3lb lower; his overall profile doesn't suggest he is likely to follow up.
runners.comment: Recorded his first win since August 2023 at Sandown 16 days ago.

races.race_name: North Downs Hospital Handicap

runners.name: Crazy Plan
runners.spotlight: 0-5 but has improved to make the frame since stepped up in trip in handicaps at Wolverhampton (1m4f) and at this track (1m2f); looks sure to run her race once again.
runners.comment: 0-5 but has improved to make the frame since stepped up in trip in handicaps.

runners.name: Cormorant Rock
runners.spotlight: 0-7 and showed no improvement for first-time cheekpieces (retained) when ninth of ten at Epsom (1m2f, good to firm) eight days ago.
runners.comment: 0-7 and showed no improvement for cheekpieces when ninth at Epsom eight days ago.

runners.name: Lady Of Clover
runners.spotlight: Consistent filly who got off the mark in a classified race at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in June; in the frame twice since and her usual hood is back on; takes a significant step up in trip and holds claims if she gets home.
runners.comment: Consistent filly who got off the mark in a classified race at Wolverhampton in June.

runners.name: Pepper Fizz
runners.spotlight: Made the frame twice in maidens last year but hasn't gone on from that in handicaps; cheekpieces worn last twice are left off and the jury is out.
runners.comment: Made the frame twice in maidens last year but hasn't gone on from that in handicaps.

runners.name: Angel Breeze
runners.spotlight: Ran a shade better on belated return when third of five in a Yarmouth novice (1m2f, good to firm) 17 days ago in first-time tongue-tie (retained); more required for this step up in trip on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Ran a shade better on belated return when third in a Yarmouth novice 17 days ago.

runners.name: Notable Charm
runners.spotlight: Had been progressing steadily until being beaten 39l at Salisbury (1m4f, good to firm) last month in first-time cheekpieces which are now replaced by first-time blinkers; all of a sudden he has questions to answer.
runners.comment: Had been progressing steadily until being beaten 39l at Salisbury last month.

runners.name: Turton
runners.spotlight: Well held in four starts for James Tate, including on handicap debut at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm; first-time blinkers) in June; since purchased for 3,400gns; last of six with headgear discarded on his stable debut last month; steps up in trip and best watched.
runners.comment: Well held on all five starts; steps up in trip and best watched.

runners.name: Dijon Gone
runners.spotlight: Not too far away on handicap debut at Newbury when upped to 1m2f but she found little over that trip at Windsor next time; now goes in cheekpieces with her staying power questioned for 1m4f.
runners.comment: Not too far away on handicap debut at Newbury but she found little at Windsor next time.

runners.name: Amalou
runners.spotlight: Showed little in three novices last year; steps up in trip for handicap debut and needs to show significant improvement.
runners.comment: Showed little in three novices last year; steps up in trip for handicap debut.

races.race_name: Advance Online Digital Media Group Handicap

runners.name: Betelgeuse
runners.spotlight: Scored at Southwell (1m6f, AW) last October and has been placed four times this year; may have found the drop back in trip against him when fifth of six at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) last month; cheekpieces return to replace blinkers but he may find this trip on the sharp side.
runners.comment: Scored at Southwell last October and has been placed four times this year.

runners.name: Mountbatten
runners.spotlight: Scored on his handicap debut at Southwell (1m4f, AW) in June and showed his turn is near once more when runner-up at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) 13 days ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained); should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Scored on his handicap debut at Southwell in June; runner-up at Leicester 13 days ago.

runners.name: Virtue Diligence
runners.spotlight: Was progressing steadily until his latest effort when beaten 25l at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm) 16 days ago; dons first-time cheekpieces and may have more to give.
runners.comment: Was progressing steadily until his latest effort when beaten 25l at Chepstow 16 days ago.

runners.name: Last Verse
runners.spotlight: Scored for Andrew Balding at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm) last month in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) and subsequently sold for 20,000gns; has run well at Sandown and Ascot for new stable and should go well on AW debut.
runners.comment: Has run well for new yard at Sandown and Ascot and should go well on AW debut.

runners.name: Hebridean Nomad
runners.spotlight: In good order here when last seen at the beginning of the year, winning over 1m4f in January before being beaten a head over today's distance the following month; holds claims if ready to roll after a break.
runners.comment: Won here in January before being beaten a head the following month.

runners.name: Last Trump
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise when fifth of eight on his debut at Newbury (1m3f, good) in April; two lesser runs at Salisbury since but may do better now he steps up in trip on his AW/handicap debut.
runners.comment: May do better now he steps up in trip on his AW/handicap debut.

races.race_name: Spa At The Marriott Lingfield Restricted Maiden Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Eighth Immortal
runners.spotlight: A beaten favourite on his first two runs but has run creditably to be placed on all three starts; dons first-time cheekpieces on AW debut and looks sure to be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Has run creditably to be placed on all three starts.

runners.name: Shemiyla Star
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck on his debut at Pontefract (6f, good) in June, he didn't appear to handle the track when fourth at Epsom last month and was never involved in a hot maiden at Goodwood last time; this looks easier on his AW debut and he should go close.
runners.comment: Beaten a neck on his debut and has had excuses for last two defeats.

runners.name: Mount St
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when staying on into third at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) on her debut eight days ago; this should be easier and she holds claims.
runners.comment: Shaped well when staying on into third at Newmarket on her debut eight days ago.

runners.name: Norham
runners.spotlight: Stuck to his task well when fourth of nine on his debut at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) last month; looks sure to be suited by this step up in trip on AW debut.
runners.comment: Stuck to his task well when fourth on his debut at Chepstow last month.

runners.name: Xochipilli
runners.spotlight: 72,000euros breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; by Blue Point; half-brother to winners Divine Knight (1m; RPR 84) and Dzsingisz Kan (Hungarian 1m3f); dam unraced half-sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Thunderous, out of Italian 1m2f Listed winner; yard yet to have a juvenile winner this year and he may need more time.
runners.comment: Yard yet to have a juvenile winner this year and he may need more time.

runners.name: Planet Bluebird
runners.spotlight: Second foal; by Massaat; dam 1m2f-1m4f winner (including AW; RPR 64), half-sister to winners Birdlover (US 6.5f/1m stakes) and Birdolini (7f 2yo), out of prolific 6f/7f winner; debutant who is likely to need more time.
runners.comment: Debutant who is likely to need more time.

runners.name: Pirates Paradise
runners.spotlight: Stayed on well when fifth of nine on his debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) 20 days ago; should know more this time and holds claims on AW debut.
runners.comment: Stayed on well when fifth on his debut at Yarmouth 20 days ago.

runners.name: Casablanca Dream
runners.spotlight: Beat only one home when sixth of seven on debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago; looks one for the future.
runners.comment: Beat only one home when 6th on debut at Nottingham 19 days ago; looks one for the future.

runners.name: Remember The Show
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and never in contention when last of nine on debut at Haydock (7f, good) 15 days ago; can be expected to find improvement on this AW debut.
runners.comment: Slowly away and never in contention when last of nine on debut at Haydock 15 days ago.

runners.name: Purple Dream
runners.spotlight: Hasn't beaten a rival in her two races and easy to dismiss.
runners.comment: Hasn't beaten a rival in her two races and easy to dismiss.

runners.name: Call Of The Sea
runners.spotlight: Last of eight when beaten 19l on debut at Ascot (7f, good to firm) last month; should know more on this AW debut.
runners.comment: Last of eight when beaten 19l on debut at Ascot last month.

runners.name: Brondesbury
runners.spotlight: Has only beaten one rival in his two starts and may need more time.
runners.comment: Has only beaten one rival in his two starts and may need more time.

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap

runners.name: Timely Affair
runners.spotlight: In good nick at present and landed his third win at Southwell (7f, AW) last month; 4lb higher but should continue to run well away from that track; claims.
runners.comment: In good nick at present and landed his third win at Southwell last month.

runners.name: Madame De Sevigne
runners.spotlight: Far more miss than hit this season and beat only one home at York last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Far more miss than hit this season and beat only one home at York last time.

runners.name: Dannick
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a career-low mark when scoring here (7f) last month; a shade unlucky when beaten a short head at Southwell (7f, AW) since and should not be far away.
runners.comment: Took advantage of a career-low mark when scoring here last month; short-headed since.

runners.name: Mollie Foster
runners.spotlight: Dual winner for Ed Walker but hasn't threatened in four runs this year for current connections.
runners.comment: Dual winner for Ed Walker but hasn't threatened this year for current connections.

runners.name: Daring Legend
runners.spotlight: All four wins when trained by Mick Appleby; below par on turf recently and has a bit to prove on this return to AW; first-time hood goes on alongside returning tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Below par on turf recently and has a bit to prove on this return to AW.

runners.name: Lady Manzor
runners.spotlight: Two of her three wins have been at this track (7f); has been running well recently and could well have a say here if the cards drop right.
runners.comment: Has been running well recently and could well have a say here if the cards drop right.

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap

runners.name: Stapleford Park
runners.spotlight: Sole success came when trained by Charlie Fellowes in 2024; continues to plummet in the weights and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Continues to plummet in the weights and others are preferred.

runners.name: Dreambird Dolly
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when landing a classified at Leicester (5f, good) in June; although she has gone close in handicaps on several occasions, she has not been able to land such a contest and doesn't therefore appeal for win purposes.
runners.comment: Got off the mark when landing a classified at Leicester in June.
runners.owner: T Beeches, C Stone, J Gallagher

runners.name: What A Tahoo
runners.spotlight: Has mostly been in good nick on turf this summer, winning at Ripon and Beverley; needs to transfer that form to AW (first six races of her career were on AW) but looks a player if she can.
runners.comment: Has mostly been in good nick on turf this summer, winning at Ripon and Beverley.
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Coolagh Magic
runners.spotlight: Five wins here, two of which were over today's distance; landed his first turf win in a classified at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) in June latest; withdrawn (upset in the stalls) five weeks ago; work to do back in a handicap.
runners.comment: First turf win in a classified in June; withdrawn (upset in the stalls) five weeks ago
runners.owner: Lady Emma Oshea And A Carson

runners.name: Nad Alshiba Snow
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who finished well down the field in recent starts and needs to show more.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden who finished has well down the field in recent starts.

runners.name: Harry Brown
runners.spotlight: Landed his fifth win at this venue when scoring on the turf track (5f, good to firm) in May; has held his form since, apart from when his saddle slipped at Windsor, and holds place prospects at least.
runners.comment: Landed his fifth win at this venue when scoring on the turf track in May.
runners.owner: Peter Crate And Gallagher Bloodstock Ltd

runners.name: Roman Spring
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D last November but has failed to match that level since and doesn't appeal.
runners.comment: Won over C&D last November but has failed to match that level since and doesn't appeal.

runners.name: Recon Mission
runners.spotlight: Both AW wins have been over C&D; not the force of old but has dropped to a career-low mark; doesn't win very often nowadays though and is passed over.
runners.comment: Both AW wins have been over C&D; not the force of old.

runners.name: Karinska
runners.spotlight: Resuming (16-weeks). Not beaten far Open company at Randwick first-up last preparation. Can mix form but only win was first-up.
runners.owner: Star Thoroughbreds Pty Ltd, Mrs D M Handley Et Al

runners.name: Savvy Hallie
runners.spotlight: First-up (23-weeks). Placed in the Surround in recent preparation. Can pull out a run fresh while cruising through a winning trial at Rosehill. Can dictate under Rawiller.
runners.owner: B K Racing & Breeding Pty Ltd & B J Vassallo

runners.name: Apocalyptic
runners.spotlight: Resuming (25-weeks). Flight Stakes winner. In the minors first-up last campaign while cruising through a winning trial at Rosehill. Well placed to make an impact here.
runners.owner: MyRacehorse No 1, Etak Thoroughbreds Et Al

runners.name: Gatwick
runners.spotlight: Terrific from the wide gate at Rosehill. Natural leader, gun draw and a nice weight drop. Any give helps. Can repeat dose.
runners.owner: P A Vawdrey, Mrs D M Vawdrey Et Al

runners.name: Catch The Glory
runners.spotlight: Resuming (14-weeks). Reliable first-up performer while brought on by 2 trials. Has a tricky draw and rising in weight for return. Can fire fresh in this affair with even breaks.
runners.owner: J C Coyle, B D Kirkby Et Al

runners.name: Stardom
runners.spotlight: First-up (13-weeks). Tightened up with a couple handy trial hitouts and has placed first-up. Shapes as a rough place prospect fresh in this affair.

runners.name: Prima Bella
runners.spotlight: Aiming for hat-trick. Won after handy to speed and getting the advantage late this track. Looks up to these.
runners.owner: Mrs M A Smith, Mystery Downs Et Al

runners.name: Cherry Bomshell
runners.spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (19-weeks). Percy Sykes winner who did a terrific job in her first campaign. Tuned up with a couple of trials. Keep safe.
runners.owner: Australian Bloodstock, L C Henderson Et Al

runners.name: Agrarian Girl
runners.spotlight: Second campaign (24-weeks). Speedy filly. Won the Lonhro Plate in her maiden campaign and seen in 3 trials since she last faced the starter. Respecting.
runners.owner: Horseshoe Investments Pty Ltd, D K Sarre Et Al

runners.name: Pembrey
runners.spotlight: Set for second campaign (22-weeks). Strengthened up. Won the Magic Night in her maiden campaign. Down the track in the Slipper. Warmed up with an impressive Deagon trial.

runners.name: By Choice
runners.spotlight: Resuming for second prep (23-weeks). Upside off spell. Dual stakes-placed filly. Trialed up super at Rosehill 7 Aug and has won first-up. Worth a look.
runners.owner: Rapid Equine, Mrs M N Annetts Et Al

runners.name: Screen Icon
runners.spotlight: First-up (19-weeks). Dual Stakes-placed filly. Capable of figuring fresh and has placed this t/d while showing enough in recent trials. Among the dangers.
runners.owner: Miss C J Stone, Ms M J Musgrave Et Al

runners.name: Bangkok Hottie
runners.spotlight: Issued decent challenge 3yo+ Midway (Bm72) this course first up. Strips in better shape and not out of this.
runners.owner: J L Thompson, Mrs P Thompson Et Al

runners.name: Krasina
runners.spotlight: Cleared maiden ranks at Canterbury 22 Jul. Settled off pace, rallied well but couldn't match winner at Rosehill. Drawn to get a soft run. Winner this trip.
runners.owner: W M Shelton, Mrs S E Shelton Et Al

runners.name: Global Goal
runners.spotlight: Fronting up for second campaign (16-weeks). Made immediate impact with a convincing win at Wagga. Trialled twice since, latest at Rosehill 7 Aug. Nice opening run but this is a sterner test.

runners.name: Reachin' Out
runners.spotlight: Back to the track for second campaign (19-weeks). Strong debut at Randwick-Kensington 25 Mar then struck some trouble in the Percy Sykes. Trialled twice since. Has some claims fresh in this line-up.
runners.owner: GW Holdings, F W Cook Et Al

runners.name: Coco Affair
runners.spotlight: Scored with consummate ease over 1200 at Wyong for new stable. Stiffer challenge here.
runners.owner: Werrett Bloodstock Pty Ltd, Segenhoe T'breds Australia Et Al

runners.name: Striking Alibi
runners.spotlight: Fronting up for second campaign (18-weeks). Ex Luke Fernie in WA. Strong debut at Ascot 11 Apr then backed up quickly in the Karrakatta. Given two Randwick trials. Big watch.

runners.name: Aviatress
runners.spotlight: Third outing for new trainer/ this region. Unable to make an impression in the Missile over this trip. Could find a few lengths here.

runners.name: Midnight In Tokyo
runners.spotlight: Let-up (56-days). Qlder who won the Hinkler Hcp at Eagle Farm then went home tamely in soft going at Eagle Farm at $21. Since won a Doomben trial 11 Aug. Likes some cushion and Ben Thompson down to ride. Each way.
runners.owner: D J McKenzie & Mrs M E McKenzie

runners.name: Infancy
runners.spotlight: Let-up (56-days). Ran on late from the back at Eagle Farm. Had two trials since. Hope of they get along up front.
runners.owner: Miss S M Parkinson, Mrs K Lovett Et Al

runners.name: Campione D'Italia
runners.spotlight: Kicks off second campaign (18-weeks). Took his game to another level winning the Inglis Sires' last prep and just missed in the Champagne. Two quiet trials for return and proven here. Rates well.
runners.owner: Newgate Bloodstock, China Horse Club Racing Et Al

runners.name: Disneck
runners.spotlight: Resuming (24-weeks). Went close in Open company at Rosehill first-up last campaign. Has an adverse draw and up in weight for return. Can play a role fresh in this affair with even breaks.
runners.owner: Bjorn Baker Racing Syndicate, S Craig Et Al

runners.name: Enriched
runners.spotlight: Resuming (15-weeks). Has mixed form but a proven fresh performer while winning a recent trial without much pressure. Ticks the track and distance win box and a big show fresh in this company.
runners.owner: T M Board, Mrs M Board Et Al

runners.name: Carbonados
runners.spotlight: Strong win from just off the leaders at Rosehill second-up. Draw makes the job harder but won only other time at Randwick. Danger with repeat.
runners.owner: Lindsay Park Bloodstock, Glentree Racing (B Wilson) Et Al

runners.name: Soothsayer
runners.spotlight: Let-up (63-days). Latest conquest (Bm85) at Eagle Farm 6 Jun. Wore them down late at Ipswich. Since trialled at Gold Coast 11 Aug. Not out of this.
runners.owner: D P Azzopardi, D L Todd Et Al

runners.name: Matcha Latte
runners.spotlight: First-up (19-weeks). Consistent through last prep. Prov-Midway C'ship Qual (C5) winner Hawkesbury 7 Mar. Cruised through a winning trial at Rosehill. Each way.

runners.name: Autumn Glow
runners.spotlight: Resuming (19-weeks). Elite performer tuned with 2 trials, drawn favourably and will take beating here first-up.

runners.name: Sheza Alibi
runners.spotlight: Resuming (20-weeks). Exciting mare. Brilliant Doncaster Mile winner last preparation. Had two jumpouts. Commands attention.

runners.name: Aeliana
runners.spotlight: Resuming (21-weeks). Added the G1 Kia Tancred Stakes to her CV last prep. In the minors at Randwick first-up last campaign while brought on by 2 trials. Quality stayer who has proven effective at 1400m.
runners.owner: Star Thoroughbreds Pty Ltd, Boeara Holdings Et Al

runners.name: Midnight Dynamite
runners.spotlight: Won the Winter Challenge at Rosehill two back 18 Jul. Modest performance this venue. Effective wet. Hard fit but tougher now at WFA.
runners.owner: S G Darby, D Foote Et Al

runners.name: Idle Flyer
runners.spotlight: First-up (19-weeks). Recorded a breakthrough G1 win last campaign. Close in Open company first-up last campaign. Finds a harder setup but has a touch of class.
runners.owner: MCS Racing, A B Tall Et Al

runners.name: Lady Shenandoah
runners.spotlight: First-up (19-weeks). Strong mare consistent through last prep. Reliable first-up performer while trialling 2 times ahead of return. G1 winner this t/d. Danger.

runners.name: Gringotts
runners.spotlight: First-up (20-weeks). Right amongst it in top company. Has run well fresh while looking in good shape in recent trial. At optimum distance.
runners.owner: A Kheir, J A O'Neill Et Al

runners.name: Fangirl
runners.spotlight: Let-up (70-days). Top mare. Won the 3yo+ WFA Randwick 20 Sep. Last start this trip ran on okay without troubling in sloppy conditions at Eagle Farm. Had two trials since. Always a threat.

runners.name: Ceolwulf
runners.spotlight: Resuming (25-weeks). Quality performer. Just the two runs last prep. Given two soft trials. Could get into the placings fresh.
runners.owner: Ungar Family, W M Shelton Et Al

runners.name: Lindermann
runners.spotlight: Resuming (19-weeks). Last prep was highlighted by two G1 placings. Brought on by 2 trials and handles the wet. Can play a role fresh.

runners.name: Barnavara
runners.spotlight: Import returning for second Australian campaign (21-weeks). Better for first Aust run. Just the one assignment last prep. Could give some cheek at odds fresh in this company.

runners.name: Beiwacht
runners.spotlight: First-up (18-weeks). All Aged Stakes conqueror last time in. Adept fresh and good recent trial. Gets the gun run. Must respect.

runners.name: Autumn Boy
runners.spotlight: First-up (20-weeks). Won the G1 Rosehill Guineas last time in. In the minors first-up last campaign while warmed up with 2 trials. Each way.

runners.name: Green Spaces
runners.spotlight: First-up (20-weeks). ATC Derby winner resuming. Given two trials and is a first-up winner but has a tricky draw and prefer to see.

races.race_name: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)

runners.name: Kensington Lane
runners.owner: Agave Racing Stable, Medallion Racing & Evan Trommer

runners.name: Peanutbutterbombe
runners.owner: Little Red Feather Racing & William Strauss

runners.name: Raiding Party
runners.owner: Larry R Rodgers, James J Lamonica Et Al

runners.name: Victorious Dream
runners.owner: Eclipse Thoroughbred Partners, Sabby Racing & Michael House

runners.name: Inbox
runners.owner: Hopeless Stables, Little Red Feather Racing Et Al

races.race_name: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)

runners.name: Om N Joy
