runners.spotlight: Progressed into very useful filly in 2025, winning five times including Grade 3 Torry Pines Stakes here (1m; by half a length) in August; improved again last two starts, winning Grade 2 Santa Margarita at Santa Anita (9f; easily by 4l) in May before half-length second to Eunomia in Clement L. Hirsch Stakes here (8.5f) this month; tougher task against makes and has to prove stamina.
runners.comment: Grade 3 and Grade 2 winner and good second last time; has to prove stamina
runners.owner: Baker Stables LLC, Scanlan Racing LLC & Michael Golovko

runners.name: Knightsbridge
runners.spotlight: High-class horse, devastating in hat-trick of Grade 3 wins at Gulfstream last winter (all in very fast time); back to form when winning Grade 3 Monmouth Cup (1m1f) by just over 10l from Money Game; has lots of early pace but has to overcome wide draw, pace pressure and needs to prove stamina at 1m2f; highly respected but may start at cramped odds, considering difficulties.
runners.comment: Easy winner up to 1m1f of three Grade 3s in 2026; good chance, if getting the 1m2f trip

runners.name: Hit Show
runners.spotlight: Late-running stamina glutton who got the perfect set-up in 2025 Dubai World Cup at Meydan (1m2f); creditable efforts this term when placed in Grade 3 Blame at Churchill Downs (1m1f; travelled strongly, short of room, caught eye in third) and Grade 2 Suburban at Saratoga (did best of the closers, 10l second to impressive front-runner Phileas Fogg); could get perfect set-up here with so much early pace signed on and looks to be coming to the boil.
runners.comment: 2025 Dubai World Cup (10f) winner; good efforts over 1m1f last two; has perfect set-up

runners.name: Forged Steel
runners.spotlight: Hard-charging front-runner; got loose early in Grade 2 at Santa Anita in May (1m2f) and proceeded to register very smart effort in winning by nearly 10l from Malarchuk; nowhere near same level in the face of even mild pressure, including last time, and will not find this group accommodating.
runners.comment: May have been flattered when 9.5l winner of Grade 2 penultimate start (1m2f); passed over
runners.owner: C2 Racing Stable LLC, Mathis Stable LLC & TCC Stables LLC

runners.name: Navajo Warrior
runners.spotlight: In tremendous form, completing hat-trick in allowance at Gulfstream and Grade 3s at Pimlico (9.5f) and Prairie Meadows (9f); set strong pace and stayed on well to win by three and a half lengths from Bullard in Cornhusker Handicap on latter occasion; should give another good account but this is tougher.
runners.comment: Hat-trick scorer, including pair of Grade 3s; claims but may find it difficult to dominate
runners.owner: Bag Racing Stables, Miller Racing Et Al

runners.name: British Isles
runners.spotlight: Clearly best effort to win five-runner Grade 1 Santa Anita Handicap (1m2f) in March by 5l from Vodka Vodka; disappointing since in Grade 3 at Keeneland and Grade 2 Hollywood Gold Cup (1m2f), in latter 10l behind Forged Steel; hard to trust.
runners.comment: Best effort to win Grade 1 at Santa Anita (1m2f) at March; disappointing since and opposed
runners.owner: Slam Dunk Racing, Debby Baltas & Cynthia McClanahan

runners.name: Finger
runners.spotlight: Japanese-trained colt by Gun Runner; won Listed Tokyo Derby at Ohi in June (1m2f, muddy) by about a length in 16-runner field (second-fastest time in race history); it's hard to be confident how he fits in terms of class but he is nicely drawn; promising young trainer saddled 2024 Breeders' Cup Turf runner-up Rousham Park.
runners.comment: Japanese-trained colt who won Listed Tokyo Derby (1m2f, muddy) in fast time; interesting

runners.name: Full Serrano
runners.spotlight: First home of the front-runners when third to Skippylongstocking in strongly run Grade 1 Pegasus World Cup at Gulfstream (1m1f) in January, then stumbled badly start when 3l fourth to Nu What's New in Grade 3 Oaklawn Mile in March; runner-up two years ago and looks to have been laid out (trainer has won this four times) but faces so much pressure up front.
runners.comment: Caught eye both times in 2026; second two years ago but may face too much pace pressure

runners.name: Original Sin
runners.spotlight: Curlin colt who won Grade 3 Blame Stakes at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May; stiffer task when well-beaten ninth in Grade 2 Suburban Stakes at Saratoga (1m2f) last time (Forged Steel fifth); this is more difficult still.
runners.comment: Grade 3 winner; struggled in Grade 2 last time and now faces stiffer task; hard to fancy

runners.name: Malarchuk
runners.spotlight: Useful form, lightly raced; runner-up at Santa Anita in 2026 in allowance race and Grade 2 Hollywood Gold Cup (1m2f), in latter beaten nearly 10l by Forged Steel after latter established a clear early lead; needs to step up a good deal to defeat these.
runners.comment: Second in allowance and Grade 2 this year, beaten 9.5l by Forged Steel in latter; opposed
runners.owner: ERJ Racing LLC & Reddam Racing LLC

runners.name: Subsanador
runners.spotlight: High-class horse at his best, winner of three Grade 1s, two in Argentina and California Crown Stakes at Santa Anita (1m1f) in September 2024; not the same force of old and tailed off in Grade 2 last time; opposed.
runners.comment: Three-time Grade 1 winner, latest in 2024; not the force of old and tailed off latest

races.race_name: Ballston Spa Stakes Presented By Stihl (Grade 2) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)

runners.name: Segesta
runners.spotlight: Has proved herself a top performer and has recorded plenty of wins at this level; was on the premises in the Diana Stakes (runner-up, beaten half a length) when ahead of Ozara last month; an easier task than her previous race; strong claims.
runners.comment: Plenty of appeal; runner-up in the Diana Stakes five weeks ago.

runners.name: Deep Satin
runners.spotlight: This C&D holds no fears; admirably consistent; not beaten too far (2 1/2l) in an allowance listed when behind the reopposing And One More Time last month.
runners.comment: Fair effort five weeks ago; has been consistent of late.
runners.owner: John D Gunther & Eurowest Bloodstock Services

runners.name: Grayosh
runners.spotlight: Managed two wins in her last three outings; has scored over C&D; successful by 1l at Monmouth Park last month in an allowance Grade 3; possible squeak despite being up in class.
runners.comment: This represents a step up in class but has to be respected.

runners.name: And One More Time
runners.spotlight: Career record shows her ability to win (wins-runs record of 5-10); got the job done by just over 1l here over 1m (allowance listed) last month; a likely player despite this step up in class.
runners.comment: This represents a step up in class but should not be far away.

runners.name: Sunlit Uplands
runners.spotlight: Progressive filly, successful in 7f handicaps at Haydock and Sandown last year; made the frame in two pattern races in GB and Italy before landing a weak Group 2 at Hamburg last month; pick of her form has been on soft ground, so this quicker ground is a concern; needs to improve again too.
runners.comment: Improving filly but be led by the betting on this first start on these shores.

runners.name: Scalable
runners.spotlight: Finished fourth, beaten 14l, in an allowance Grade 2 (Monmouth Park) last month upped to this distance; has achieved six wins from 20 career runs.
runners.comment: Held in fourth last month; a proven winner with a career wins-runs record of 6-20.

runners.name: Ozara
runners.spotlight: Out of the money and beaten 8l in the Diana Stakes (behind Segesta) last month upped to 1m1f; this might be easier; can't be ruled out as has some big wins on the CV.
runners.comment: Should not be ruled out as has some big wins on the CV;

runners.name: Play With Fire
runners.spotlight: Problems at the start (problems in the gate) over 1m here (allowance optional claimer) six weeks ago when not beaten far.
runners.comment: Not beaten far last month; wins-runs record of 2-9.

runners.name: Long Ago
runners.spotlight: Successful five times from 22 career runs; behind Grayosh over 1m1f at Monmouth Park (allowance Grade 3) when on the premises, finishing second at 7-1 last month; others appeal more as regularly been coming up a bit short lately; also engaged in race 7 at Monmouth Park.
runners.comment: Easy enough to take on as regularly been coming up a bit short lately.

races.race_name: Alabama Stakes Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Dirt)

runners.name: Counting Stars
runners.spotlight: Had two of these in arrears when winning the Coaching Club American Oaks by just over 4l 28 days ago; yet to taste defeat at this track, winning on two visits and has achieved six wins from ten career runs; big player.
runners.comment: Has to be feared; won Saratoga Coaching Club American Oaks 28 days ago.

runners.name: Nycon
runners.spotlight: Held here last month by Counting Stars when well beaten in the Coaching Club American Oaks; a lot on her plate here and looks risky.
runners.comment: Others appeal more given many of her rivals are in good form.

runners.name: Ati Girl
runners.spotlight: Best form so far in last two starts; won a maiden special weight by 2 1/2l, breaking her duck at the ninth time of asking last month; tried over an additional 1f now.
runners.comment: Scored by 2 1/2l 37 days ago; has kicked on in her last couple of races.
runners.owner: Gary Barber, Wachtel Stable & Pantofel Stable LLC

runners.name: Measure
runners.spotlight: Finished third, beaten 7l by Counting Stars when held in the Coaching Club American Oaks four weeks ago; not dismissed if duplicating the form of her most recent win.
runners.comment: Possible squeak if in the same mood as when achieving most recent success.
runners.owner: Gary Barber, Bridlewood Farm & Eclipse Thoroughbred Partners

runners.name: My Gun's Loaded
runners.spotlight: Aiming to complete a hat-trick and winner of two of her three runs to date; gained a 3l success last month in an allowance optional claimer; in with a shout.
runners.comment: Ought to give it a shot; got the job done four weeks ago.

runners.name: A. P.'s Girl
runners.spotlight: Consistent performer; finished third beaten just under 3l at Churchill Downs over 1m 1/2f (black type) in June; others are preferred with stamina to prove at this new trip.
runners.comment: Makes limited appeal with stamina to prove at this new trip.

races.race_name: Criterium du Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Listed Race) (Turf)

runners.name: Hedged
runners.spotlight: Resuming (22-weeks). In the G1 placings last time in. Missed by a bee's lip in Open company at Cranbourne first-up last time in. 1st & 2nd at latest jump-outs. Looks well suited here.
runners.owner: R T D Racing, G N Franklin Et Al

runners.name: Extragalactic
runners.spotlight: Resuming (15-weeks). Right amongst it in top company last time in. Has run 4th at past couple of jump-outs. Watch closely for a lively first-up performance.
runners.owner: T W Hennessy, Choochoo Racing Et Al

runners.name: Ole Dancer
runners.spotlight: First-up (23-weeks). In the G1 minor spoils last campaign. Usually strikes form quickly. Recent Pakenham jump-out winner. Worth some thought.
runners.owner: Werrett Bloodstock P/L Syn, Whitby Bloodstock P/L Syn Et Al

runners.name: Stokke
runners.spotlight: Unable to make an impression in soft going at Caulfield Heath after lengthy absence. Awkwardly drawn. Can't enthuse.
runners.owner: R C Salter, S Collette Et Al

runners.name: Klabel
runners.spotlight: Ordinary performance in small field in soft going at Caulfield Heath second-up. First time around Sandown-Hillside. Lacks appeal here.
runners.owner: N Morgan, J F Naffine & Bula Bula

runners.name: Losesomewinmore
runners.spotlight: Let-up (49-days). Put in some good work late at Flemington. Went close only other go this course and trip. Could get into the placings.

runners.name: Cavalry Girl
runners.spotlight: Aiming for hat-trick. Donkey-licked them at Morphettville two back. Led, responded strongly to score in small field at Caulfield Heath over this journey. Hard to beat.
runners.owner: J O'Neill, M Curtain Et Al

runners.name: Bazaball Rewarded
runners.spotlight: Secured third in a staggered finish at Caulfield Heath over this trip. Has an adverse draw. Could add some value to exotics.
runners.owner: G N Peters, J Baker Et Al

runners.name: Signature Scent
runners.spotlight: Now 4 weeks between runs. Caulfield winner two back. Handily placed and worked home soundly at Caulfield. Consider at an each-way price.

runners.name: Beast Mode
runners.spotlight: Made all and just picked off late at Randwick over today's trip. Can show early speed. Form sound at this course and journey and under less weight. Capable of making an impact.
runners.owner: Best Bloodstock Syndicate, Broady Cats Syndicate Et Al

runners.name: Along The River
runners.spotlight: In the minor spoils but still well held at Caulfield Heath over today's trip. This looks more demanding.
